title: FP&A Specialist | Credit
description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America through innovative technology and outstanding customer service. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies.
Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the role

The challenge of our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team is to help Nubank make better financial decisions. Our mission is to understand the company’s performance from a financial perspective by analyzing past results and creating projections for the future. Broadly speaking, our team is divided into FP&A Horizontals, FP&A Markets, FP&A Global Products, FP&A Efficiency, and Procurement.

Key Responsibilities:
• Analyzing, explaining, and forecasting the financial results of the Credit Card Business Unit;
• Improving FP&A processes to generate insights and clarity in income statements, always thinking in a scalable way with reliable data;
• Understanding and analyzing the impacts of product-related decisions on the results of the Business Unit (BU);
• Automating reports by connecting them with databases from different sources;
• Building, updating, and reviewing financial models and simulators;
• Creating and presenting executive materials with financial results to the Business Unit and Leadership team.

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience in financial analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet), credit analysis, or related areas;
• Has strong analytical skills to manage and evaluate complex data;
• Possesses strong communication skills to proactively engage with different business partners and stakeholders (Product, Finance, Markets);
• Has advanced knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets;
• Is fluent in English;
• Programming knowledge (Scala, SQL, and Python) is a plus.

Bewerbung und Position

Position: Erzieher/Erzieherin // Kindheitspädagoge/ Kindheitspädagogin

Ort: Kindergarten der deutschen Auslandsschule

Bewerbungsfrist: Bitte angeben

Tätigkeitsbeginn: ab 02/2026

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

Anstellungsdauer: 2 Jahre Vertrag, dann unbefristet

Aufgabenprofil

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianische Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen bereits im Kindergarten in zwei Kulturkreisen, was ihnen erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes vermittelt.

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit ausgeschrieben. Neben der pädagogischen Tätigkeit wird die Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen erwartet.

Aufgaben

  • Arbeit in den Kindergartengruppen in deutscher Sprache (Deutsch ist Muttersprache!)
  • Teilnahme am Schulleben
  • aktive Beteiligung am Entwicklungsprozess des Kindergartens
  • Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung

Anforderungen

Gesucht werden engagierte Erzieher/Erzieherinnen oder Kindheitspädagogen/Kindheitspädagoginnen, die Freude am Umgang mit Kindern im Alter von 2 bis 5 Jahren haben und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Wichtige Eigenschaften sind Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation, Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Kenntnisse in Portugiesisch sind kein Muss, werden aber während des Arbeitsverhältnisses gefördert.

  • Ausbildung als ErzieherIn / KindheitspädagogIn
  • Berufserfahrung wünschenswert
  • hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier, Arbeitsfreude
  • Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit

Unser Angebot

Ein interessantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten Team. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der Gehaltsrichtlinie der Schule und liegt über dem Landesdurchschnitt. Zusätzlich gibt es Leistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung, Mietzuschuss sowie Umzugs- und Flugkostenpauschalen bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland.

Bewerbung

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Unterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschlüsse, Fortbildungsnachweise) per E-Mail im PDF-Format an: (Kontaktangabe). Idealerweise in einer Gesamtdatei.

Der Schulleiter, Thomas Duque Mand, freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Weitere Informationen

  • Aktuelle Vorstellung Porto Seguro (2022)
  • Deutsches Curriculum an der Porto Seguro

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.
  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.
  • Realização de controles internos utilizando o sistema jurídico interno.
  • Acompanhamento legislativo e reporte à gerência e diretoria jurídica sobre os impactos das alterações legislativas no negócio, com foco em legislação socioambiental,incluindo atualizações e análises sobre o EUDR e outras regulamentações internacionais relevantes.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, considerando os riscos legais, reputacionais e financeiros associados ao descumprimento do EUDR.
  • Elaboração de relatórios dedue diligence em direitos humanos e sustentabilidade,com foco na diligência devida e os requisitos de rastreabilidade e transparência da cadeia de suprimentos do EUDR.

Outras atividades:

  • Participação em grupos de trabalho, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentesstakeholders ,com foco em EUDR e outras questões socioambientais relevantes.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) desta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com a legislação e as melhores práticas: A atuação do(a) advogado(a) garante que os projetos e as operações da empresa estejam em conformidade com as leis e normas socioambientais, evitando sanções e danos reputacionais. Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e dos direitos humanos: O(A) profissional atua ativamente na implementação de políticas e práticas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, contribuindo para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável. Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders .
  • Fortalecimento da reputação da empresa: A atuação jurídica ética e responsável na área de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos contribui para o fortalecimento da imagem da empresa perante seus stakeholders , gerando valor para a marca e atraindo investimentos.

Alcance dos objetivos estratégicos especialmente focados na área de consultoria jurídica para as áreas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.

Castanhal, Pará, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  1. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  2. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  3. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  4. Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  5. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento. Conheça um pouco mais do(a) Agente Stone em nosso manifesto.

  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Vamos aprofundar nas suas hard skills para avaliar habilidades e competências específicas, além de apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Rota Teste: Você vivenciará a rotina na prática, acompanhando um(a) dos(as) nossos(as) agentes durante a rota.

Check de Cultura: Papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura para garantir alinhamento com nossos valores e visão de futuro.

Feedback: Compartilharemos o resultado e os próximos passos, independentemente do resultado.

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Location: Remote

About the Founder Institute:

The Founder Institute (FI) is a global network of startup incubators, accelerators, and investors on a mission to activate and empower communities of entrepreneurs worldwide.

Since 2009, we’ve helped launch over 8,000 companies in 200+ cities globally, which have raised nearly $2BN in funding. We are based in Silicon Valley and have remote team members across the United States, Europe, India, and Brazil. Our success has been documented in the New York Times , BusinessWeek , Forbes , TechCrunch , and more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Growth Marketing Manager with a passion for startups and entrepreneurship to join our team.

The Growth Marketing Manager will lead the strategy and execution of all FI public online events, and be tasked with significantly increasing event attendance across all events.

You will report directly to the Co-Founder & CEO of FI, have the opportunity to see entrepreneurship and venture capital from many angles, and work with a small and mission-driven team.

This role is 100% remote.

Our Culture:

At the Founder Institute, we work a lot like the early-stage startups we support. That means things move fast, and we thrive on creativity, ownership, and a “let’s figure it out” mindset.Here’s what we look for in our team:

  • You’re naturally entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and enjoy tackling challenges head-on.
  • You prefer autonomy over hand-holding and don’t need a lot of oversight to get things done.
  • You love learning new things, and when you hit a roadblock, your first instinct is to dig in, research, and find a solution—Google is your best friend.
  • You’re open to feedback (even when it’s tough), and always looking to grow and improve—both personally and as part of the team.

If that sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you. If not, no hard feelings—this kind of environment isn’t for everyone.

Still with us? Great—read on for more details!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Increase Event Attendance at Online Events: The main KPI for this role is event attendance, and the Growth Marketing Manager will independently test, develop, and execute new strategies to increase attendance at FI’s global and local online events - on a miniscule marketing budget .
  • Develop and Maintain Guidelines and Best Practices for Local FI Chapters: Develop local event marketing strategies, frameworks, and best-practices that can be executed by Local FI Chapters to increase attendance on local online events.
  • Train and Collaborate with Local FI Chapters: Train FI Chapters on the latest findings and best practices, troubleshoot their issues, and leverage their experience to form new strategies that can be deployed across other chapters.
  • Coordinate and Plan Global Online Events: Collaborate with other members of FI HQ to source, book, and coordiante with speakers for FI’s global online events.
  • Host and/or Produce Online Events:Collaborate and alternate with other members of FI HQ to host (emcee) online events, and/or produce them in the background to support the host.
  • Improve Site and Email Copy: Update and improve copy across our marketing materials to properly address the changing needs of our customers.
  • Maintain Organized Documentation & Processes: Track customer interactions, document frequently asked questions, and provide feedback to improve processes.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required:

  • 5+ years of online marketing experience
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Business-level fluency in English
  • Comfort on camera (you will host some live webinars with up to 1000 live attendees)
  • Knowledge of startup accelerators and the startup/ venture capital industry
  • Ability to execute with a miniscule marketing budget, and limited support resources
  • Experience running content marketing and social media marketing campaigns from beginning to end
  • Working knowledge and familiarity with common online event and marketing tools (ex. Zoom, Airmeet, Squarespace, Slack, Google Suite, Asana, Moz, Notion, Jasper, Canva)

  • Proactive attitude and ability to operate in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment (there is no micromanagement at FI)

Preferred:

  • Public Relations experience
  • Basic HTML/ CSS/ design experience
  • Experience using Powerpoint, Excel, Canva, Mailchimp, and various online CRM and marketing platforms

What We Offer:

  • Great upward mobility into a larger, conversion-focused marketing role (all senior team members at FI have grown into their roles from inside the company)
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Ability to join FI's Equity Collective, providing monetary upside in FI Alumni companies
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with the autonomy to drive results in your own style.

  • Ability to learn from top entrepreneurs, investors, and executives throughout FI’s global network and suite of acceleration programs.

IMPORTANT: In your Cover Letter please write two paragraphs, the first on why you would like to work in the startup accelerator industry, and the second on how your personality fits well with the FI culture described above. Applications without this Cover Letter will be ignored.

No Dia Mundial do Meio Ambiente, reforçamos nosso posicionamento de que saúde e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Aqui esse compromisso vai além do discurso — ele se traduz em práticas concretas, alinhadas à Agenda 2030 e aos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS) da ONU.Como signatários do Pacto Global, estruturamos uma gestão ambiental robusta, com diretrizes, metas e práticas integradas ao nosso Planejamento Estratégico. Nossa atuação se destaca em frentes como:- Gestão de resíduos: mais de 300 toneladas foram encaminhadas para reciclagem ao longo da trajetória da instituição — 42,58% desse total apenas no último ano. Além disso, mais de 2.300 itens hospitalares obsoletos foram doados, beneficiando mais de 13 mil pessoas.- Nutrição sustentável: conquistamos o selo Pin 4 do Green Kitchen nas duas unidades, com horta própria, produção interna e menos plástico descartável.- Logística reversa e circularidade: o uso de embalagens retornáveis evitou o descarte de mais de 7 toneladas de papelão. Mais de 6 toneladas de resíduos eletroeletrônicos foram destinadas à reciclagem, resultando no plantio de 128 mudas de árvores nativas.- Preservação ambiental: na Unidade Paulista temos uma área verde preservada, com espécies nativas e árvores de grande porte, reafirmando o compromisso com a biodiversidade urbana.Também participamos ativamente das Plataformas de Ação do Pacto Global e do Projeto Hospitais Saudáveis, assumindo desafios em resíduos, compras sustentáveis e energia, com foco contínuo em práticas que transformam o setor da saúde.O futuro da saúde depende de uma relação equilibrada e consciente com o meio ambiente — e seguimos firmes nessa jornada.#ParaTodosVerem : a imagem possui texto alternativo.#DiaMundialDoMeioAmbiente #Sustentabilidade #PactoGlobal #Agenda2030 #ESG #ODS #HospitalAlemãoOswaldoCruz

Braganca Paulista, Sao Paulo, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  1. Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  2. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  3. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  4. Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  5. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento.

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta | 44h semanais.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes mantendo um relacionamento contínuo e pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.
  2. Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  3. Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  4. Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga.
  5. Rota Teste: Nosso objetivo é que você vivencie a rotina proposta na vaga na prática, ou seja, você acompanhará um(a) dos(as) nossos(as) agentes durante a sua rota.
  6. Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia!
  7. Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

description:
A Agência Estado é uma empresa do Grupo Estado (Jornal O Estado de S. Paulo) e atua no mercado há mais de 50 anos, oferecendo soluções para tomada de decisão de profissionais que atuam nos segmentos financeiro, de agronegócio, corporativo, político e de energia.

A Agência Estado é líder no segmento financeiro nacional, com mais de 10 mil assinantes da plataforma Broadcast+, entre instituições financeiras e governamentais, empresários, executivos, investidores pessoas físicas e profissionais liberais.

Relatório de Transparênciae Igualdade Salarial de Mulheres e Homens

Em cumprimento ao determinado pela Lei 14.611/2023, publicamos o Relatório de Transparência e Igualdade Salarial de Mulheres e Homens elaborado pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, relativo aos dados do ano de 2022.

Esclarecemos que mesmo apoiando os princípios de igualdade plena de direitos e obrigações entre mulheres e homens e mais especificamente a igualdade de critérios de remuneração independentemente de qualquer distinção de sexo, etnia e quaisquer outros fatores discriminatórios, o relatório do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego que estamos publicandonão cumpre totalmente seu objetivo de aferir a igualdade salarial e de critérios remuneratórios entre mulheres e homens para a realização de trabalho de igual valor ou no exercício da mesma função. Isso acontece porque o relatório não compara remunerações para as mesmas funções, mas para grupos de funções de características e complexidade extremamente distintas. Por isso, acreditamos que as conclusões do relatório elaborado pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Empregonão refletem a realidade de nossa empresa em relação aos critérios de remuneração efetivamente adotados para o exercício da mesma função por mulheres e homens.

A fim de melhor atender aos princípios de transparência e igualdade previstos na Lei, estamos buscando pelos meios adequados o aperfeiçoamento, por parte do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, do tratamento dos dados de remuneração fornecidos pela empresa.

DIRECTOR OF ACCOUNTING AND FINANCE

The Director of Accounting and Finance will oversee all financial activities, including accounting, financial planning, analysis, and reporting. This role is critical to the strategic growth and financial health of the company. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the finance team, ensuring compliance with financial regulations, and providing insights to support decision-making at the executive level.

Key Responsibilities :

  1. Lead and manage the accounting and finance team, providing guidance and support to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
  2. Develop and implement financial strategies, policies, and procedures to enhance the company’s financial performance.
  3. Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.
  4. Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal financial regulations and standards.
  5. Prepare and present financial reports to the executive team and stakeholders.
  6. Conduct financial analysis to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
  7. Manage cash flow, investments, and financial risk.
  8. Collaborate with other departments to support overall business objectives and strategies.
  9. Coordinate audits and work closely with external auditors to ensure accurate and timely completion.
  10. Stay informed about industry trends, economic conditions, and regulatory changes.


Qualifications :

  5. Strong knowledge of financial regulations, standards, and best practices.
  6. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  7. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  8. Proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
  9. High level of integrity and professionalism.

COMMERCIAL DIRECTOR

Purpose

To make company a successful provider of information to the automotive industry and market in Brazil.

Consult customers on the best way forward to achieve their requirements with the use of company products.

Main Responsibilities

To develop a clear strategy for new business sales growth in Brazil in line with the company’s business plan.

To deliver increased sales, revenue and market share to all parts of the automotive marketplace:Automotive, Leasing, Finance and Banks, Retail and Digital Marketplace and Automotive Insurance.

To review the capabilities of the existing local sales team, create development plans and focus on their development with regards to new solution sales and propositions aligned to consultative sales approach.

To further develop the existing sales structure to optimise revenues and resources within the allocated market.

To lead and coach the local Sales team (supervises one account manager and may hire additional, as needed to grow the market) and support the development of a sales-led culture where accountability for delivery against a sales budget becomes the norm.

Identify quick wins within market to drive new business and implement analysis and response for key regional competition.

To establish new market potential in line with the company’s regional growth plans including market analysis of sales potentials, development and implementation of sales plans and ensure effective strategic planning in line with expected “Return on Investment” targets.

To ensure effective knowledge transfer on all company products, services and solutions is carried out within company guidelines to create a more effective sales platform in all agreed market.

To provide clear and accurate forecasting of all renewal, new business, and growth opportunities for Brazil.

Assist the Area Manager to prepare annual budget for Brazil conforming to company budgeting process and policies.

Provide direction and support to optimize market penetration in each sector. Ensure Regional sales infrastructure capable of driving new services and product success across the four market verticals.

To ensure structures, processes and procedures are in place at both pre and post sales level to deliver customer satisfaction targets.

The Commercial Director for Brazil reports to the Regional Director for Latin America.

Join to apply for the Human Resources Manager role at Polaris Inc.

At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. Our people make us who we are, and we create incredible products and experiences that empower us to THINK OUTSIDE.
Job Summary
The Human Resources Manager (HRM) is a strategic business partner supporting our Digital & Information Technology and Legal corporate functions. Through robust partnership with business leaders, the HRM will develop and execute an HR strategy aligned to business needs to drive business results and deliver value-added support to managers and employees. This position is responsible for assessing, anticipating and providing day-to-day HR support. The HRM will be a leader to attract, develop & retain top talent, to shape organizational culture and promote Polaris values, and to design the organization (strategy, structure, people, processes and rewards). The HRM must also demonstrate HR functional excellence and strong partnership with our HR Centers of Excellence in the execution of HR initiatives and annual processes (HRIS, Organizational Development, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, etc).
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Talent: Attract, Develop and Retain Top Talent

  • Lead talent management for the organization, including identification of talent needs and active participation in talent acquisition efforts, to deliver strategic and operational needs of the organization
  • Own development planning process for team; identify & activate against developmental trends and capability gaps for broader team, as well as champion employee plans individually
  • Partner with high potential employees on career planning
  • Lead succession planning for organization through intentional development of key talent to build a strong bench for leadership positions
  • Build and maintain a strong leadership team through coaching, mentoring and development at all levels
Organization: Design, Build and Deploy an Organization to Win
  • Partner with leaders on organizational design for the team, considering factors such as: headcount needs, span of control, and overall team performance & effectiveness
  • Design roles with clear responsibilities & ownership; ensure broad communication of how roles fit into the organizational design and strategy
  • Develop a build vs. buy strategy for organizational capabilities, leverage agencies or external contractors for flexibility
  • Implement processes and invest in technology to drive organizational efficiencies
  • Coach leaders to set clear vision & strategy for team; check pulse of employee clarity; champion activities such as annual goal setting and ongoing work prioritization/execution
  • Support cross functional team integration and partnerships at all levels
Culture: Define and build a compelling and unbeatable culture
  • Act as a steward for building a strong team culture aligned with the Polaris Values
  • Actively develop and foster a positive climate, high employee engagement, and overall team effectiveness and integration
  • Maintain visibility and active presence within the team to be a credible and trusted resource
  • Coach leaders on high standard of leadership behaviors & actions
  • Provide daily support and communication across all levels of the organization to enable high-performing teams

Local de Trabalho: Santa Rita do Sapucaí - MG.

O Instituto Nacional de Telecomunicações é um centro de ensino, pesquisa e desenvolvimento de tecnologias, criado em 1965. Foi a primeira instituição de ensino superior de Engenharia de Telecomunicações do Brasil. Desde a fundação, o Inatel caminha junto às importantes decisões no que diz respeito a telecomunicações, tecnologia da informação, informática e todos os ramos da tecnologia.

A instituição possui mais de 800 colaboradores alocados em Santa Rita do Sapucaí, sul de Minas Gerais, região conhecida nacional e internacionalmente como o “Vale da Eletrônica” e em outras cidades do Brasil de forma remota.

Áreas de atuação:

  • Ensino – atualmente oferece sete cursos de graduação - Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Software e Engenharia de Telecomunicações; além de pós-graduação lato sensu, cursos a distância e ainda Mestrado e Doutorado em Telecomunicações.
  • Pesquisa - A instituição desenvolve pesquisas nas áreas de Comunicações Ópticas e Sem Fio, Redes e Rádios Cognitivos e Redes de Computadores e mais recentemente, iniciou estudos sobre o acesso à Internet banda larga sem fio, enlaces de comunicação via satélite, radioenlaces de longo alcance e grande capacidade e, principalmente, redes de comunicações móveis de 5ª Geração, por meio da implantação do Centro de Referência em Radiocomunicações (CRR), projeto entre Inatel, FINEP, MiniCom e Funttel.
  • Desenvolvimento de tecnologias - além de formar profissionais, o Inatel transfere tecnologia ao mercado nas áreas de desenvolvimento de Software, Hardware, Educação Continuada, Consultoria e Calibração de Equipamentos. Possui parcerias com empresas de grande porte nacionais e multinacionais.

Somos o Inatel!

Queremos inspirar pessoas para que descubram a tecnologia, para que conheçam a inovação e tenham a melhor experiência educacional do Brasil.

description:
Líder de Equipe de Consultores Comerciais

Para alcançar o objetivo de impulsionar o crescimento dos empreendimentos de nossos clientes, construímos nosso time recentemente, onde nos comprometemos a elevar continuamente nossa proposta de valor. O Agente Digital desempenha um papel fundamental em nossa estratégia de pós-venda, garantindo um atendimento personalizado e inovador por meio dos canais mais adequados para cada cliente.

A fim de construir um time dedicado a revolucionar o padrão de relacionamento com o cliente, buscamos profissionais apaixonados e empreendedores, prontos para desafiar o status quo e oferecer uma experiência com um diferencial competitivo no mercado.

Como é ser um Líder de Equipe de Consultores Comerciais Internos?

Você será responsável pelo time de agentes digitais que possui como missão atuar de forma estratégica para construção do relacionamento com o cliente, a fim de reter, rentabilizar e impulsionar o empreendimento da sua carteira. Além disso, entre as suas atribuições estão:

  • Desenvolver planos de ação a fim de criar estratégias para rentabilizar as carteiras de clientes (aumentando as vendas e reduzindo o Churn)
  • Análise de métricas de sucesso operacional e melhoria contínua.
  • Analisar e estudar tendências de mercado e concorrentes
  • Treinar e desenvolver o time de agentes para garantir que tenham as habilidades necessárias para o alcance dos resultados esperados.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano de experiência em cargo de liderança/supervisão;
  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano na área comercial;
  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo;
  • Comunicação clara e efetiva;
  • Foco em resultados, priorizando o alcance das metas.
  • Capacidade analítica, interpretação de dados, transformando insights em ações.
  • Identificar oportunidades e problemas antes de eles se manifestarem, busca soluções inovadoras para superar desafios e gerar valor.

Escala e modelo de trabalho:

Due to rapid business growth, we’re expanding our team. In capital markets, both buy-side and sell-side firms aim to automate and streamline operations across asset classes — and Bloomberg is a key partner in making that happen. Our Enterprise Technology Services team plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability and performance of Bloomberg’s products, as well as the custom integration solutions our clients rely on. Financial firms operate with dozens of interconnected systems to manage trading, evaluate risk, track P&L, and ensure timely settlement. But integrating these systems is complex, costly, and time-consuming. That’s where we come in. Enterprise Technology helps clients simplify this complexity. We provide trusted tools, technical expertise, and seamless connectivity that reduce costs, accelerate implementation, and improve transparency. With our deep understanding of capital markets and track record delivering hosted solutions, Bloomberg is uniquely positioned to support our clients’ integration strategies.

What’s the Role?

  • As an Enterprise Technology Service Representative / Technical Relationship Manager, you'll be a key point of contact for our South American client base. You’ll work alongside our global team to support and grow our business by delivering technical application support and integration expertise.

  • Based in-region, you’ll also partner with Pre-Sales to engage prospective clients and demonstrate Bloomberg’s value. Your focus will be on supporting a broad range of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) workflows between Bloomberg and client systems — spanning protocols such as SWIFT, FIX, XML, SFTP, MQ, and Web APIs.

  • Your role is two-fold: to ensure stable, secure workflows and to build trusted client partnerships. You’ll be the go-to technical advisor for a set of strategic accounts, proactively managing integration health and helping clients get the most from our solutions.

  • You’ll also act as the voice of the client — collaborating with Product Managers, Business Leads, and Engineers to shape our offerings based on real-world feedback and market dynamics.

Who You Are?

  • You bring purpose and energy to your work. You're passionate about technology, curious by nature, and committed to delivering an exceptional client experience. You’re at your best when solving complex problems, navigating change, and stepping up to new challenges.

  • You value being part of a team — and your colleagues and clients know they can rely on you. You’re not afraid to question the status quo, share new ideas, and help others do their best work.

  • Most of all, you care about making an impact: supporting clients, strengthening relationships, and representing Bloomberg with integrity and insight.

We’ll Trust You To

  • Deliver outstanding production support to clients across the Americas, with a focus on South America

  • Own and resolve technical issues — proactively following through and communicating clearly

  • Support the full client lifecycle: from pre-sales, implementation through post-deployment care

  • Troubleshoot issues across Bloomberg’s electronic trading and reporting suite, identifying root causes and delivering timely solutions

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to design enhancements and prevent recurring issues

  • Act as a technical liaison — aligning expectations, streamlining delivery, and ensuring success across client and internal stakeholders

  • Analyze trends in client issues, implement preventive strategies, and share insights to improve system stability

  • Monitor client flows and trading activity to support capacity planning and performance benchmarking

  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, tailoring your message accordingly

  • Keep clients aligned with our technology roadmap and proactively manage expectations

You’ll Need to Have

  • Bilingual fluency in Portuguese and English

  • 4+ years in technical support or implementation roles for electronic trading systems

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Familiarity with Fixed Income, FX, and/or Equities workflows, including regulations like MiFID and SFTR

  • Hands-on experience with message protocols such as FIX, SFTP, or MQ

  • An understanding of network concepts and troubleshooting connectivity issues

  • Ability to document and explain complex technology stacks clearly

  • Calm under pressure, with sharp prioritization skills and a strong sense of urgency

  • Proven track record of solving complex issues and collaborating with senior technical stakeholders

  • Ability to identify commercial opportunities and support Pre-Sales engagement, working closely with Account Management to drive client success

  • Willingness to travel as needed

  • Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered

We’d Love to See

  • A degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

  • Exposure to programming or scripting languages (e.g., Pythonl)

  • Familiarity with XML, JSON, and SWIFT messaging formats

  • Working knowledge of SQL and experience with transactional databases, both structured and unstructured

  • Strong understanding of Equity, Futures, Options, Fixed Income, and FX market workflows

  • Exposure to workflows at broker/dealers, exchanges, hedge funds, or involving regulatory reporting requirements

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

About us

We are Insider, a B2B SaaS company that drives growth for its clients around the world. How are we achieving this? We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 1200+ brands from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Coca-Cola, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Virgin, Nestle, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Dominos, CNN, and the list goes on.

Having unlocked unicorn status, Insider was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world, to achieve $200M in CARR (Committed Annual Recurring Revenue). Insider was named a leader in The Forrester Wave for Cross-Channel Campaign Management 2021, and Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omnichannel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023 Assessment. The company has been recognized in The Top 1% of all software companies worldwide in G2’s 2024 Software Awards , and named in The Top 10 Best Software Products with the most #1 rankings alongside other software legends like Google, Zoom, and Monday.com . According to G2’s Spring’24 reports. Insider is also the #1 G2 Leader in 6+ categories , including Customer Data Platforms (CDP), Personalization Engines, Personalization Software, Mobile Marketing, Customer Journey Analytics, and e-commerce Personalization.

When our team founded Insider, they not only sought to create a product company but also to build the most socially progressive technology community in the world. Through our corporate social responsibility initiatives like 100Projects SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact into our communities across 27+ countries, spearheading transformative projects in areas such as health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing the proportional representation of women in STEM careers.

Behind all these achievements, there is an exceptionally talented and passionate team across 27+ countries that moves fast and agile, creates cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to join us on this journey, just keep reading.

Good salespeople need two things: world-class innovative products and convenient commercials to cater to their prospects. Well, we offer world-leading products and a flexible commercial. These give us a starting point, but for most of us, that is just not enough. We like betting on ourselves to score the highest possible in this game, to climb the highest mountain, and to be the best there is. We are not only disrupting the tech ecosystem and democratizing the market but we are also disrupting the entire Saas sales community as well. All because we have a different style of sales. That's why we were able to expand so rapidly and we will never stop. If you want to know more about how not only to disrupt product & development but also disrupt B2B Saas sales, join us!


We want you to join us while we are taking a step into the future if you;
  • have a university degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields ,
  • have previous experience in retail, e-commerce, and travel industries which is a big plus!
  • have solid experience in SaaS Industry.
  • Knowledge of Martech (Digital Marketing, CX) is a must!
  • can show us that “You’ve got what it takes! ” to collaborate and build strong relationships with partners, especially at the executive level; remember, we don’t make a sale, we make a partner!
  • have proven oral and written communication abilities, positive and energetic phone skills and exquisite listening skills;
  • are a self-motivated, savvy tech bug , always in search of savvy solutions and ideas to improve our relationship with our partners ; alas, we’ve got partners all over the world!
  • can cherish one of our core ethos: care. You’ll need to care for our partners and make sure they feel at home with our products and our around the clock support;
  • have time and project management skills;
  • have a keen eye for detail! Passion for testing, measuring, and improving outreach and follow up effectiveness ;
  • have the ability and flexibility to work in a fast-paced startup environment as well as high emotional intelligence .
  • While this isn't a team management role, you will still have the opportunity to share your expertise with the rest of the team and even lead them in internal projects.
While we are conquering the world, we are offering you:
  • a chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment ;
  • to be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences ; Don't believe us? Just ask Google.
  • access and opportunity to gain a limitless network all over the globe
  • access to many hard and soft skills pieces of training to help you improve and challenge yourself.
  • access to our one of a kind training sessions on Sales; "Sales University"
  • access to 16,000+ online courses taught by real-world professionals on the LinkedIn Learning platform to satisfy your hunger for knowledge;
  • space to share your skills through training sessions and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring!
  • Our working model embraces the best of both worlds with a delightful hybrid approach, where we head to the office three times a week to foster creativity, collaboration, and a vibrant team spirit
  • the infamous team activities that are bursting with fun,
  • no Dress Code!

title: Gipser/in (m/w/d) – Fachkraft für Trockenbau und Verputzarbeiten
description:
Das Gipsergeschäft ist ein etabliertes Unternehmen im Bereich der Bau- und Renovierungsbranche. Mit langjähriger Erfahrung bietet das Gipsergeschäft qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen rund um Trockenbau, Verputzarbeiten und Innenausbau. Das Ziel ist es, innovative Lösungen für private und gewerbliche Kunden zu schaffen. Das Gipsergeschäft setzt auf nachhaltige Materialien und moderne Techniken, um den Kunden ein Höchstmass an Zufriedenheit und Komfort zu bieten. Als wachsendes Unternehmen suchen wir zur Verstärkung des Teams eine/n engagierte/n Gipser/in (m/w/d) mit Leidenschaft für präzise Handwerksarbeit.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Gipser/in (m/w/d) bei dem Gipsergeschäft übernehmen Sie eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle bei der Durchführung von Trockenbau- und Verputzarbeiten sowohl in Neubauten als auch in Renovierungsprojekten. Sie sorgen dafür, dass alle Arbeiten nach höchsten Qualitätsstandards und unter Beachtung der Sicherheitsvorgaben ausgeführt werden.
Ihre Aufgaben umfassen das fachgerechte Verputzen von Wänden und Decken in Innenräumen sowie die Durchführung von Trockenbauarbeiten, wie zum Beispiel dem Bau von Wänden, Decken und Abtrennungen. Sie bereiten Oberflächen für anschliessende Maler- oder Tapezierarbeiten vor und stellen sicher, dass alle Arbeiten präzise nach Planvorgaben und technischen Zeichnungen ausgeführt werden. Dabei arbeiten Sie mit verschiedenen Materialien wie Gips, Lehmputz und anderen Trockenbaumaterialien und sind eng mit anderen Gewerken auf der Baustelle in Zusammenarbeit. Die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards gehört ebenso zu Ihren Aufgaben wie die Pflege und Wartung der verwendeten Werkzeuge und Maschinen.

Wir erwarten

Wir erwarten eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gipser/in, Trockenbauer/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Trockenbau und Verputzarbeiten. Sie sollten über Erfahrung im Umgang mit verschiedenen Putzarten und -techniken verfügen und sowohl teamfähig als auch zuverlässig sein. Eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise ist uns ebenso wichtig wie Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, verschiedene Aufgaben im Bauwesen zu übernehmen. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wäre von Vorteil, ist jedoch nicht zwingend erforderlich.

Wir bieten Ihnen ein abwechslungsreiches und verantwortungsvolles Aufgabengebiet in einem dynamischen Unternehmen, das Ihnen eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen sichert. Zudem haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich durch Weiterbildungsangebote durch das Temptraining.ch fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. In unserem angenehmen Betriebsklima arbeiten Sie mit einem motivierten Team zusammen und profitieren von einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld, das mit hochwertigem Equipment und Arbeitsmaterialien ausgestattet ist. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Chance, eigenverantwortliche Projekte zu übernehmen, gehören ebenso zu unseren Angeboten wie die Möglichkeit, an spannenden Neubau- und Renovierungsprojekten teilzunehmen.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir Bewerbungen per Post gerne berücksichtigen, aus administrativen Gründen jedoch nicht zurückschicken können.

title: Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery
description:
Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Are you looking for a dynamic, growth-oriented career working with extraordinary people with a mission to provide world-class products and customer service? Rotoflow , An Air Products Business, may be the place for you!
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM providing a comprehensive range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our global customers. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include our wide-ranging proprietary turbo-expanders and related equipment consisting of new equipment designs, upgrades and repairs along with a full complement of supporting services. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
We are currently seeking a Mechanical Designer to join our team at our global headquarters in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. This role involves minimal travel.
Do you have a passion for precision design, solving unique engineering challenges, and contributing to world-class machinery development? Rotoflow is looking for a Mechanical Designer who thrives in a collaborative environment and is excited to work on high-speed rotating machinery and support systems. If this sounds like you, come grow with us as we continue to build a sustainable tomorrow together.
Rotoflow Employees Enjoy

  • Being part of a world class engineering, manufacturing, and business organization developing machinery solutions for our customers,
  • Collaborating with a multi-functional team across sales, engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope,
  • Tapping into the wealth of technical experience available within Rotoflow and the opportunity to explore technical interests,
  • Being part of a team of highly motivated individuals,
  • Seeing projects come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing,
  • The ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Responsible for equipment design and development, layout, detailed part drawing creation, BOM generation, manufacturing, purchasing and production support as necessary throughout projects,
  • Creation of 3D CAD models of turbomachinery components including complex geometries such as radial impellers,
  • Creation of 2D and 3D CAD layouts,
  • Creation of 2D drawings using geometric dimensioning,
  • Perform stack-up analysis of precision machinery,
  • Interface with a broad spectrum of suppliers and disposition part variations and deviations,
  • Create conceptual layouts to support new product development,
  • Perform quality and technical checks of drawings and documents as a checker,
  • Designing and creating manufacturing drawings for tooling associated with servicing turbomachinery,
  • Creation, revision, and maintenance of part numbers, part routings and bills of materials in Air Products’ ERP system (SAP),
  • The successful candidate will need to interact with colleagues including proposals, project management, engineering, shop operations, and field service engineers,
  • Promote safety and diversity consistent with the philosophies of Rotoflow.
Required Skills / Abilities
  • 2D and 3D CAD, simulation, and FEA experience a plus,
  • Working knowledge of ERP and MRP Systems a plus,
  • Knowledge of turbomachinery or other high speed rotating machinery a strong plus,
  • Time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and as a team,
  • Strong knowledge Microsoft Office tools,
  • Attention to detail and written and oral communication skills,
  • Understanding of revision control philosophy,
  • Experience with tolerancing and stack-up philosophies,
  • Experience with design of assembly tooling,
  • Experience with SolidWorks and Bentley MicroStation or AutoCAD a strong plus,
  • Experience with SAP ERP system a strong plus.
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • Associates Degree in Mechanical Design or equivalent. BS in a technical field a plus,
  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a mechanical design occupation. 10+ years' experience a plus,
  • Basic knowledge of ANSI GD&T.
Working Conditions And/or Benefits Of This Role
  • This is a full-time position based in Bethlehem, PA,
  • You will be expected to work on-site 5 days per week during initial training. There is potential to transition to a hybrid work schedule,
  • Minimal travel required,
  • Opportunity for career growth and increasing responsibility,
  • Be part of a motivated, technically skilled team,
  • See your designs come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing.
If you are dedicated and driven to achieve your objectives and company goals, have passion and commitment to get it right, have a never-ending desire to learn, improve, and contribute, then come discover, care, accomplish and thrive at Air Products!
To learn more, visit Air Products and Rotoflow.
Air Products proudly values the skills, dedication, and leadership that veterans bring to the table. As a veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome veterans to apply for various roles within our company. We recognize the unique strengths and experiences that veterans contribute, and we foster a workplace that honors your service while providing a platform for professional growth.
We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end-to-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visitAbout Air Products.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including paid holidays and vacation, affordable medical, dental, life insurance and retirement plans. You will be eligible for benefits and also be 100% vested in your retirement benefits on your first day of employment.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (U.S.). You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, citizenship, gender, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or veteran status.
Air Products is committed to working with and providing a reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail us at General application status inquiries are not answered by this mailbox rather you’ll receive an e-mail directly from our Career Center and/or the Talent Acquisition Specialist.

The Company You’ll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.
Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.
As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.
You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.
You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.
The Team You'll Work With
The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.
About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
What you'll do
Are you a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a passion for data and its application to business success? Docusign is seeking a Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll play a critical part in ensuring the effectiveness and accuracy of our sales compensation programs through robust analytics and reporting.
As a Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll leverage your expertise in data analysis to provide actionable insights that optimize sales performance, drive strategic decision-making, and ensure equitable compensation for our sales force. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys transforming raw data into meaningful business intelligence.
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Director, Sales Compensation Strategy.
Responsibility

  • Develop, maintain, and automate recurring sales compensation reports and dashboards using Tableau to track performance against targets, identify trends, and highlight areas for improvement
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of sales performance data, compensation plan effectiveness, and quota attainment to provide strategic recommendations to sales leadership
  • Identify data discrepancies and work cross-functionally to resolve issues, ensuring data integrity across all reporting
  • Support the annual and ongoing sales compensation planning process through data modeling, impact analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Prepare presentations and communicate complex analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences
  • Extract, transform, and load data from various sources, primarily utilizing SQL, to support compensation calculations and reporting
  • Work extensively with Salesforce.com (SFDC) to extract sales performance data, understand sales hierarchies, and validate compensation-related information
  • Collaborate with IT and other cross-functional teams to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities
  • Partner closely with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to ensure alignment on compensation strategies and accurate data flow
  • Respond to ad-hoc data requests and provide analytical support to various stakeholders
Job Designation
Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
What you bring
Basic
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field
  • 5+ years of experience in a data analysis role
  • Proficiency in SQL with demonstrated ability to write complex queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets
  • Proficiency in Tableau with proven experience in developing interactive dashboards and reports for business users
  • Experience with Salesforce.com (SFDC) or modern CRM tool
Preferred
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business insights
  • Experience with Python (NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn) or a willingness to learn
  • Understanding of sales compensation plan design principles systems
  • Experience in sales compensation in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Strong analytical skills, business acumen, and intellectual curiosity
  • Proven track record of gained efficiencies
  • Experience with Xactly or other Sales Incentive Compensation tools
  • Excellent organization, documentation, communication, and presentation skills
  • Proficient in Google Workspace
  • Results-driven and self-motivated with the ability to multitask
  • Effective, clear, and concise communication skills, verbal and written
Life at Docusign
Working here
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

description:

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You'll Solve

As an Automation Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and robustness of automated test suites across critical workflows and high-usage products. You will lead a team of automation engineers, drive quality strategies and ensure seamless integration of automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

    • Ensure consistent automation coverage across products, prioritizing high-value user flows and critical paths

  • Quality Assurance Execution:
    • Oversee the design and implementation of reliable automated test scenarios and regression suites using Carta-approved tools, such as Magni framework.

  • Continuous Improvement:

    • Develop self-service automation tools and streamline process improvements to enhance developer productivity
    • Track quality metrics and drive progress towards team-specific and company-wide quality goals

    • Proven experience as a QA Manager, with a strong background in automation testing
    • Proficiency in test automation frameworks using Selenium and/or Cypress
    • Solid understanding of SDLC and CI/CD pipeline integrations
    • Excellent leadership and team management skills
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

    Preferred Qualifications:
