title: Senior Art Director
description:
RAPP Dallas is looking for a Senior Art Director to join our award-winning Creative team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As aglobal, next-generation precision marketing agencywe leveragedata, creativity, technology, and empathyto foster client growth.We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

RAPP is seeking a Senior Art Director who brings strong conceptual thinking, elevated design skills, and the ability to lead projects through execution. In this role, you will drive the creative process, mentor junior team members, and collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and impactful campaigns. You will push boundaries, elevate creative work, and set the bar for design excellence.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Comprehension : Thoughtfully question briefs and help clarify objectives with an informed understanding of the client’s business and the creative ask.
  • Ideation : Self-start on ideation and lead brainstorming sessions with junior team members to inspire fresh, inclusive ideas.
  • Craft & Execution : Consistently deliver polished, flawless designs that demonstrate mastery of typography, layout, and composition.
  • Iteration & Elevation : Provide multiple, well-considered solutions to creative challenges and push beyond the brief when appropriate.
  • Directing & Managing : Manage your workflow effectively while mentoring and guiding junior team members to produce their best work.
  • Storytelling & Selling : Confidently present your concepts and designs to internal teams and clients, articulating the strategy and creative vision behind the work.
  • Business Contribution : Approach creative challenges with a business mindset, delivering work that drives results for both clients and the agency.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the development of creative concepts and designs that align with client goals and strategies across multiple media platforms (digital, social, print, etc.).
  • Collaborate with copywriters, designers, and other cross-functional team members to deliver cohesive, impactful campaigns.
  • Translate strategic objectives into visually compelling designs that adhere to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries.
  • Mentor junior art directors and designers, providing constructive feedback to help them grow their skills and confidence.
  • Present work to internal teams and clients with clarity and confidence, incorporating feedback as needed to refine the final product.
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and technologies, and proactively apply them to enhance creative outcomes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing timelines and priorities to meet deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Refine and elevate the design process, ensuring efficiency and consistency across all creative deliverables.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

  • Delivery of exceptional creative work that meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Clear and effective communication with team members and clients, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Consistent mentorship and support for junior team members, contributing to their growth and development.
  • Proactive exploration of design trends and tools, with a focus on incorporating them into creative solutions.
  • Efficient management of deliverables, ensuring work is on time, on brand, and on brief.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience : 4+ years of art direction experience, with a portfolio showcasing produced work across digital, print, and social media.
  • Design Craft : Mastery of typography, layout, color theory, and composition, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Technical Proficiency :
    • Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) .
    • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch is a must .
    • Experience with PowerPoint, Keynote, and Adobe Acrobat is a bonus.
    • Curiosity about experimenting with AI tools and emerging design technologies.
  • Leadership : Ability to mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a culture of collaboration and creativity.
  • Communication : Confident and persuasive presentation skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • Adaptability : Thrive under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver exceptional work in a fast-paced environment.

Our Hybrid Work Model:

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

RAPP provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Healthcare & Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts, vacation, sick, and personal days and positive activism days, paid parental leave and disability benefits. For more information regarding Omnicom benefits, please visit . A reasonable estimate of the salary for this role, at the time of posting, is $72,000 - $94,000. This range is specific to Dallas and multiple factors are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to: skill set, experience and training, certifications; etc. This is an exempt position. If your requirements fall outside of this range, you are still welcome to apply.

As an Independent Power Producer,Voltalia operates in over 20 countries, developing, building, and maintainingrenewable energy projects and services across five key technologies: solar,wind, hydro, biomass, and storage. At Voltalia, we welcome individuals from all backgrounds, whatever your race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, and experience. In our company, diversity drives innovation and contributes to a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availiability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic Vision-
  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

O Grupo GCB está em plena expansão. Somos um grupo financeiro puljante , com crescimento acelerado e um objetivo claro: sermos uma das empresas mais relevantes do mercado de capitais brasileiro .

Estamos estruturando nossa área de Wealth Management , com um modelo de relacionamento fee based , totalmente alinhado às melhores práticas globais. Aqui, o Private Banker é muito mais do que um assessor: é um estrategista financeiro e parceiro de confiança dos nossos clientes , ajudando-os a proteger e potencializar seus patrimônios.

COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA

  • Prospectar e desenvolver uma base própria de clientes alta renda .

POR QUE ENTRAR PARA O TIME GCB AGORA?

  • Estamos em forte expansão e você pode ser protagonista deste crescimento .
  • Participar de um projeto do zero , com visão de longo prazo e plena liberdade para empreender .
  • Aqui, seus resultados têm visibilidade e geram reconhecimento real .
  • Modelo fee based , que prioriza a ética, a performance e a confiança .
  • Potencial de crescimento acelerado , num grupo que respira inovação e meritocracia

No Grupo GCB, a nossa cultura não é apenas um conceito — é a força que impulsiona cada conquista. Somos movidos pela paixão por desafios, pela inovação que transforma e pela coragem de buscar o extraordinário.

Aqui, acreditamos que quem faz acontecer não espera a oportunidade perfeita — cria a sua própria. Agimos como donos, tomamos riscos de forma consciente e buscamos resultados exponenciais com pragmatismo, velocidade e impacto real.

Nesses 16 anos de história, crescemos de forma sustentável e construímos um ecossistema que conecta investimentos, esportes e inovação: a GCB Capital, a GCB Sports, a GCB Investimentos, o PeerBR e o Adiante Recebíveis. Empresas diferentes, mas que compartilham o mesmo DNA: ética inegociável, inovação como meio e foco incansável em resultado.

Somos protagonistas da nossa história e protagonistas do futuro. Aqui, não basta resistir às adversidades — é preciso ser antifrágil: usar cada desafio como combustível para crescer ainda mais forte. Valorizamos a autonomia, a iniciativa, a vontade de agir antes de pedir, e a coragem de fazer diferente.

Se você acredita que grandes alturas são para quem se atreve a sonhar grande e agir rápido, explore nossas oportunidades e venha construir essa jornada com a gente.

Até onde conseguimos chegar? A curiosidade de descobrir essa resposta é o que nos move todos os dias.

Missão do Cargo:

Desenvolver, integrar e otimizar soluções baseadas em modelos de linguagem de larga escala (LLMs) para IA generativa voltada à personalização da experiência do cliente, automação de atendimento e geração de conteúdo inteligente.


Main responsibilities

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de IA generativa com foco em LLMs (Meta Llama, Cohere, Mistral, ChatGPT, Bert e outros);
  • Integrar APIs de modelos de linguagem com sistemas internos da Livelo;
  • Trabalhar com fine-tuning, prompt engineering e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Avaliar e melhorar a performance dos modelos com base em métricas de NLP;
  • Monitorar e corrigir vieses, alucinações e falhas nos modelos;
  • Documentar processos, decisões técnicas e boas práticas.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Linguagens: Python (obrigatório) e Java (desejável);
  • Vivência PaaS / SaaS e APIs (REST/GraphQL);
  • Transformers (Hugging Face);
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow;
  • FastAPI ou Flask;
  • Conhecimento de um ou mais modelos de LLM(Meta Llama, Cohere, Mistral, ChatGPT, Bert e outros);
  • Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • CI/CD e versionamento de modelos (MLflow, DVC);
  • Experiência com RAG, embeddings (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate).
  • Desejável:
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em IA, NLP ou Machine Learning;
  • LangChain, LlamaIndex;
  • Ferramentas de fine-tuning e quantização (LoRA, PEFT, QLoRA);
  • Docker, Kubernetes;

• Promover junto ao negócio reuniões recorrentes para compreensão do desempenho do negócio.

Estamos há mais de 20 anos no mercado automotivo!
A história do Grupo Carrera teve início em 2002, com a marca Chevrolet em São Paulo.
Em 2014, o grupo deu mais um passo em direção ao crescimento com a Volkswagen, abrindo lojas em Osasco e Alphaville.
Na sequência, em 2015, o grupo foi nomeado Concessionário Nissan, estabelecendo lojas em São Paulo, Vale do Paraíba e Interior.
Em 2019 uma nova nomeação Chevrolet, dessa vez em Brasília, com o desafio de ajudar no processo de recuperação do share da capital do País.
Em 2020, o Grupo Carrera deu um novo passo estratégico ao começar a atuar com a marca Renault, com lojas em São Paulo e Cotia.
De olho na nova perspectiva de veículos híbridos e elétricos, alinhando-se com as demandas crescentes por tecnologias mais sustentáveis, o grupo expande em 2022 com a marca GWM.
Já em 2023 o grupo incorpora a marca de motos Bajaj, fortalecendo sua presença em Brasília e ampliando seu portfólio de produtos para atender às necessidades dos consumidores de duas rodas.
Atualmente, temos mais de 30 lojas do grupo, localizadas na Grande São Paulo e Brasília.
E nosso grupo só cresce: Hoje estamos com 1500 colaboradores!
A matriz fica situada em São Paulo e conta com diversos departamentos internos inovadores, como T.I e Marketing, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Financeiro, Fiscal, Compras/Manutenção e soluções financeiras por meio do setor de F&I. Além disso, o grupo possui Seguradora e Blindadora própria.
Nosso PROPÓSITO é Facilitar o acesso das pessoas a produtos de mobilidade e serviços relacionados.
Missão: Viabilizar aos nossos clientes a melhor solução de mobilidade e serviços relacionados.
Visão: Ser reconhecido como um dos maiores grupos de soluções de mobilidade do Brasil, reconhecido pela ética e inovação na prestação de serviços e como referência em local para se trabalhar

title: Prefeitura e Funed selecionam parceiros para calendário esportivo de 2025
description:
Prefeitura e Funed selecionam parceiros para calendário esportivo de 2025

Chamamento público seleciona Organização da Sociedade Civil para realização do Calendário Esportivo de Dourados. Foto: A. Frota

Com a finalidade de selecionar propostas visando à celebração de parcerias na organização de eventos esportivos previstos para todo o ano de 2025, a Prefeitura de Dourados, por meio da Fundação de Esportes de Dourados (Funed), lançou edital de chamamento público para a transferência de recursos financeiros à Organização da Sociedade Civil (OSC), sem fins lucrativos, qualificada, que possua experiência comprovada na gestão de eventos esportivos, para a administração eficiente e eficaz de eventos que atenda a esses objetivos.

Conforme o edital de chamamento público nº 001/2025, publicado no Diário Oficial desta quarta-feira, 2 de abril, a seleção será regida pela Lei Federal n° 13.019, de 31 de julho de 2014, pelo Decreto Municipal n° 2.710, de 24 de novembro de 2016 e demais normativos aplicáveis. A OSC selecionada receberá apoio financeiro no valor de até R$ 371.229,50 (trezentos e setenta e um mil e duzentos e vinte e nove reais e cinquenta centavos) pela execução do projeto, voltado à realização de nove eventos esportivos previstos para 2025.

O chamamento público é uma medida necessária para garantir a transparência, a isonomia e a competitividade, permitindo que as OSCs possam apresentar suas propostas de forma objetiva e compatível com as necessidades e especificidades dos eventos planejados. Além disso, a utilização de OSCs é um mecanismo de gestão que permite maior flexibilidade e inovação na execução de atividades esportivas, respeitando os princípios da administração pública e possibilitando a otimização dos recursos públicos.

Poderão participar deste Chamamento Público as Organizações da Sociedade Civil (OSC), assim consideradas aquelas definidas pelo art. 2°, inciso I, alíneas “a”, “b” ou “c”, da Lei Federal n° 13.019/14:

  1. entidade privada sem fins lucrativos que não distribua entre os seus sócios ou associados, conselheiros, diretores, empregados, doadores ou terceiros eventuais resultados, sobras, excedentes operacionais, brutos ou líquidos, dividendos, isenções de qualquer natureza, participações ou parcelas do seu patrimônio, auferidos mediante o exercício de suas atividades, e que os aplique integralmente na consecução do respectivo objeto social, de forma imediata ou por meio da constituição de fundo patrimonial ou fundo de reserva;
  2. as sociedades cooperativas previstas na Lei Federal nº 9.867, de 10 de novembro de 1999; as integradas por pessoas em situação de risco ou vulnerabilidade pessoal ou social; as alcançadas por programas e ações de combate à pobreza e de geração de trabalho e renda; as voltadas para fomento, educação e capacitação de trabalhadores rurais ou capacitação de agentes de assistência técnica e extensão rural; e as capacitadas para execução de atividades ou de projetos de interesse público e de cunho social;
  3. as organizações religiosas que se dediquem a atividades ou a projetos de interesse público e de cunho social distintas das destinadas a fins exclusivamente religiosos.

As propostas deverão ser entregues na sede da Fundação de Esportes de Dourados (Funed), situada à Rua Itamarati, 100 – Jardim Água Boa, de segunda a sexta-feira, no horário 8h às 13h, exclusivamente no prazo final que será de trinta dias após a publicação do Edital no Diário Oficial do Município, o horário de recebimento das propostas será até às 11h, horário de Brasília/DF.

É garantido o sigilo quanto ao conteúdo das propostas até a data de sua abertura em sessão pública a ser realizada no primeiro dia útil após o encerramento do prazo para recebimento das propostas, às 13h, na sede da Funed.

I – Corrida do Trabalhador , no dia 1º de maio, com medalha de participação e premiação individual por categoria (Geral / Fem. / PCD e Infantil)

II – Interdistrital , a partir de 7 de julho até 20 de dezembro, com premiação individual e coletiva;

III – Seletiva 2026, Jogos Escolares de Dourados (JED) de 12 a 14 ano, de 04 de agosto a 30 de outubro, com premiação individual (Modalidade e Categoria);

IV – Seletiva 2026 Jogos da Juventude (JOJUD) de 15 a 17 anos, de 04 de agosto a 30 de outubro de 2025, com premiação individual e coletiva (Modalidade e Categoria);

V – Jogos Abertos de Dourados (JADS) , de 11 de agosto a 25 de novembro de 2025, com premiação individual e coletiva (Modalidade e Categoria);

VI – Torneio Inter Escolinhas da Funed , dias 13, 20 e 27 de setembro, com premiação individual e coletiva (Modalidade e Categoria);

VII – Corrida Rosa , dia 5 de outubro, com medalha de participação e premiação individual por categoria (Geral / Fem. / PCD e Infantil);

VIII – Corrida do Servidor Público , dia 26 de outubro, com medalha de participação e premiação individual por categoria (Geral / Feminino / PCD e Infantil);

IX – Jogos do Servidor , dia 28 de outubro, com premiação individual (Modalidade e Categoria).

title: Grupo RIC divulga nota oficial manifesta-se sobre tentativa de intimidação
description:
O grupo RIC Paraná divulgou no início desta tarde nota oficial sobre o episódio envolvendo o vereador Geremias Vicente da Silva (PL) e o apresentador Nader Khalil, por causa de um comentário feito no programa Balanço Geral, da RICtv Maringá. Acompanhado de outros dois homens, o vereador foi pessoalmente à emissora para, segundo a nota, intimidar e ameaçar o apresentador.

Além da nota oficial, o Grupo já enviou notificação para a presidência da Câmara Municipal, ao corregedor do Legislativo e ao líder do Partido Liberal na casa. O vereador deve se manifestar hoje a respeito do caso. Confira o teor da nota oficial:

“No dia 29 de janeiro de 2025, o Grupo RIC Paraná noticiou, no programa “Balanço Geral”, a indicação apresentada pelo vereador Geremias Vicente da Silva ao prefeito de Maringá, Sr. Sílvio Barros, que sugeria a concessão de folga remunerada aos servidores públicos no dia de seus aniversários.

Por se tratar de matéria de alta relevância social e abrangência pública, o vereador foi ouvido e entrevistado antes da veiculação da notícia, com o objetivo conceder o seu posicionamento sobre a indicação apresentada. A notícia em questão, pelo próprio formato de programa ao vivo no qual foi exibida, também contou com a participação de telespectadores os quais puderam contribuir com suas opiniões nas plataformas de redes sociais do programa, enriquecendo o debate público, que o programa busca fomentar enquanto veículo de comunicação.

Importante salientar que a conduta do apresentador se deu estritamente nos limites do dever de informar sem quaisquer excessos, ademais, ainda que as críticas tivessem sido externadas pelo apresentador, estariam igualmente protegidas pela liberdade de expressão e pelo legítimo direito de crítica, sobretudo por se tratar de proposição oriunda de um vereador eleito, figura pública local e sujeita a maior escrutínio da população e seus eleitores.

Após a divulgação, o vereador, descontente com a repercussão, buscou impor suas opiniões de forma indevida, adotando postura de intimidação e ameaça contra nossa equipe e, em especial, contra o apresentador Nader Khalil.

Embora tenha sido reiteradamente orientado a apresentar seus questionamentos pelos canais formais e institucionais do Grupo RIC, o vereador optou por ignorar esse procedimento e comparecer à sede da emissora de maneira a constranger os profissionais que ali estavam, numa evidente tentativa de suprimir o direito e dever constitucional de informar, bem como impor algum tipo de confrontação direta com o apresentador, o que por óbvio não lhe foi concedido.

Ressalta-se que todo veículo de comunicação está aberto à crítica pública e pode, caso se verifique algum equívoco, ser submetido aos mecanismos legais de contestação. Entretanto, o Grupo RIC Paraná repudia veementemente qualquer prática baseada em ameaça, coação ou intimidação, reafirmando que os cidadãos têm à disposição vias legítimas previstas em nossa legislação para sanar eventuais divergências, sem jamais recorrer a atitudes que comprometam o diálogo institucional, algo que deveria ter sido observado pelo vereador enquanto membro da casa legislativa municipal.

Ademais, como pontuado, o Grupo RIC possui também canais institucionais de comunicação os quais buscam dar voz direta aos cidadãos.

Por fim, enfatizamos que esta manifestação não carrega qualquer conotação de natureza partidária ou ideológica, pois entendemos que os fatos em questão refletem unicamente a conduta isolada do vereador.

Lamentamos profundamente que, em lugar de buscar a via do entendimento, tenha optado pela intimidação, postura que não será admitida por este veículo de comunicação. Reafirmamos nosso compromisso de informar com rigor, transparência e respeito à ordem constitucional, confiando nos princípios democráticos que asseguram a liberdade de imprensa e a proteção aos profissionais de jornalismo.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A área do Design de Visualização é responsável pelo suporte em apresentações dos produtos em diversos níveis, seja internamente, durante o desenvolvimento das etapas do desenvolvimento, seja no momento das suas aprovações, ou ser o output na apresentação final dos projetos para a grande mídia! Dependendo da necessidade, elas podem ocorrer de forma 2D, com imagens fotorealistas ou em Real-Time. Em algumas demandas específicas a criação de vídeos também se faz muito necessária! A área do Design de Visualização é hoje uma ferramenta fundamental para o atingimento do sucesso durante todo o processo!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Designer de Visualização é o responsável por transmitir de forma ultra-realista todo o conteúdo produzido pelo time de Shape Design e Modelação 3D.

Através de softwares específicos (como VRED, por ex) o profissional cria imagens virtuais de altíssima qualidade e realismo que são usadas tanto em apresentações e reviews internos, quanto em apresentações onde os projetos são aprovados pelo Board da empresa (no Brasil e Alemanha) chegando até as imagens do lançamento do produto que são veiculadas na mídia.

Vídeos também são elaborados com o intuito de atender certas demandas específicas.

É necessário e fundamental o total envolvimento e parceria com os designers para que os briefings sejam compreendidos e as demandas sejam atingidas com sucesso.

Ter responsabilidade, consciência do processo e promover a autogestão para um eficiente controle entre inicio e entrega de cada trabalho complementam os requisitos.

title: Especialista em Automação Intralogística | CD Cabreúva/SP
description:
Employment type: Full-Time

Job Description

Quer contribuir com o Ecossistema das Lojas Renner S/A?

Olha o que essa oportunidade desenvolverá no dia a dia.

Será Especialista em Automação Industrial para suportar as equipes de manutenção e operação intralogística do maior e mais tecnológico Centro de Distribuição omnichannel da companhia. Contribuir com a implementação das rotinas técnico-operacionais da unidade. Gerir projetos e melhorias futuras nos equipamentos e processos. Monitorar indicadores de performance dos sistemas automatizados de recebimento, armazenagem e distribuição.

Main responsibilities

  • Gerir projetos de automação, elétrica e eletrônica com ênfase em soluções intralogísticas de armazenagem e distribuição de produtos em caixa e cabide;
  • Verificar características técnicas de sistemas de automação com base na documentação técnica de diferentes fornecedores de máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Avaliar planos de testes, acompanhar e validar cenários de produção dos sistemas de automação em período de start-up e ramp-up da planta;
  • Executar trabalhos com eletricidade, conforme normas estabelecidas pela NR10, tais como: montagens e atendimento em quadros elétricos de baixa tensão e média tensão, CCMs, comandos de potência, redes industriais, barramentos elétricos;
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento técnico funcional dos equipamentos e sistemas durante as fases de implementação do projeto;
  • Analisar gráficos de tendências e relatórios de operação e manutenção em produção, para avaliação de throughput do sistema implantado;
  • Realizar interface direta com o hotline de atendimentos emergências reportando as situações apresentadas no campo com base nas informações da equipe técnica;
  • Orientação técnica-operacional na implementação de projetos de melhoria contínua de processos e equipamentos, relação direta com as áreas de operação, engenharia e manutenção;
  • Acompanhamento e análise de Indicadores Chaves de Processos (KPIs) macro operacionais de processos, sistemas e equipamentos;
  • Implementar Indicador de Eficácia Global (OEE) da planta e definir estratégias para replicação e benchmark dentro da plataforma logística da companhia;
  • Capacitação de colaboradores internos dos times de manutenção e operação nos níveis de auxiliares, assistentes, líderes, técnicos, supervisores e engenheiros;
  • Suporte aos pares de gestão da manutenção, coordenadores de automação e facilities, na definição de estratégias de investimentos e custos operacionais (CAPEX e OPEX).

Requirements and skills

Obrigatório :

  • Formação Superior concluída em Tecnologia e/ou Engenharia Automação/Computação/Elétrica ou Análise de sistemas ou similares;
  • Formação em NR10;
  • Conhecimentos de NR12;
  • Experiência sólida em Manutenção Industrial e Processos Produtivos;
  • Conhecimentos em Softwares de Automação: TIA Portal, TwinCAT e SCADA;
  • Conhecimento em linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimentos em Redes Industriais: Ethernet, EtherCAT, Profinet, Profibus e AS-i.

Diferenciais :

  • Vivência em comissionamento e start-up de projetos de automação intralogística;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gerenciamento de plantas logísticas WCS e WMS;
  • Conhecimento de gestão de projetos e melhoria contínua dos processos (Lean Six Sigma);
  • Pós Graduação em Automação Industrial, Manutenção ou Logística;
  • Inglês Avançado (Leitura e Conversação).

Additional information

Modalidade de trabalho: Presencial

Local de Trabalho: Cabreúva/SP

Lojas Renner is the largest Brazilian department stores clothing company, headquartered in Porto Alegre - Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.

Obrigatório :

  • Formação em NR10;
  • Conhecimentos de NR12;
  • Experiência sólida em Manutenção Industrial e Processos Produtivos;
  • Conhecimentos em Softwares de Automação: TIA Portal, TwinCAT e SCADA;
  • Conhecimento em linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimentos em Redes Industriais: Ethernet, EtherCAT, Profinet, Profibus e AS-i.

Diferenciais :

Additional information

title: Cientista de Dados Jr
description:
Se você é analítico(a), curioso(a) e gosta de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas, essa vaga pode ser para você!
Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados para atuar na área de Engenharia de Dados, desenvolvendo soluções preditivas e aplicações com IA generativa. Sua missão será identificar oportunidades de negócio a partir da modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise de grandes volumes de dados.

Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Python : pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost
  • Banco de dados : SQL e NoSQL
  • Estatística aplicada : distribuições, testes de hipóteses, regressões
  • Inglês : leitura técnica para consultas e referências online

Responsabilidades principais

  • Ingestão e tratamento de dados : escrever consultas SQL e scripts de extração em bancos relacionais e não-relacionais; padronizar, normalizar e enriquecer datasets.
  • Pipeline de dados em Python : implementar fluxos de ETL com pandas e outras bibliotecas para tratar os dados a serem utilizados.
  • Modelagem preditiva : desenvolver, treinar e validar modelos de classificação e regressão (scikit-learn, XGBoost), identificando perfis e oportunidades de upsell/cross-sell.
  • Data augmentation : projetar e aplicar técnicas de ampliação de dados (SMOTE, bootstrapping, sintetização) para melhorar a robustez em cenários com poucos exemplos.
  • Monitoramento e manutenção : acompanhar métricas de performance (ROC-AUC, F1-Score, Precision/Recall), automatizar alertas de deriva de dados e retrainings quando necessário.
  • Colaboração multidisciplinar : trabalhar junto aos times de Produto e Marketing para definir hipóteses, planejar testes A/B e traduzir resultados em insights acionáveis.
  • IA generativa : prototipar soluções com LLMs (ChatGPT, GPT-4, etc.) ou ferramentas open-source para automação de relatórios, chatbots internos e enriquecimento de dados textuais.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Senior Quality Engineer. In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world - creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don't just come here to work, they come here to grow - solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.


Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:


• Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect• Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
• Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably


Overview:


The Senior Quality Engineer demonstrates a high level of professionalism, prioritizing the quality, reliability, and performance of systems and applications within the Business Technology, Innovation, Development, and Data Analytics department. This role involves leading quality assurance initiatives, mentoring junior team members, and driving continuous improvement of processes. The Senior Quality Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing test strategies, analyzing complex data, and ensuring adherence to quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle. This role requires a deep understanding of software testing methodologies, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Essential Functions:


Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive test strategies and plans, covering all aspects of software quality, including functionality, performance, security, and usability.
Design, develop, and execute test cases, document test results, and track defects using appropriate tools and methodologies.Mentor and guide junior quality engineers, providing technical expertise and support to enhance their skills and knowledge.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business analysts, to ensure alignment on quality goals and objectives.
Lead root cause analysis of software defects and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence and improve development processes.
Drive continuous improvement of quality assurance processes and methodologies by researching and implementing industry best practices and new technologies.
Develop and maintain clear and concise documentation for all quality assurance activities.
Proactively identify potential quality risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Provide technical guidance and support to other team members on quality-related matters.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

QUE TAL TRABALHAR EM UMA EMPRESA A SERVIÇO DAS CIDADES INTELIGENTES DO AMANHÃ?

A INDIGO é líder mundial em gestão de estacionamentos e mobilidade individual. Estamos em mais de 500 cidades de 10 países. No Brasil, são mais de 370 operações em 97 cidades de 24 estados + DF.

Sabe como a gente faz tudo isso acontecer?

Ao redor do mundo, contamos com mais de 9 mil colaboradores – dos quais 4.700 são brasileiros. Todos eles atuam no gerenciamento de soluções personalizadas e cada vez mais inteligentes, que viabilizam uma jornada tranquila e integrada para o cliente.

Uma das prioridades da INDIGO é ouvir seus funcionários e garantir que eles tenham carreiras bem-sucedidas. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos e na criação de políticas de desenvolvimento. Além disso, nos esforçamos para fomentar a igualdade de gênero, promover oportunidades iguais e combater a discriminação. Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho onde todos se sintam realizados, motivados e engajados.

Mais propósito, menos impacto, mais Indigo

Estamos transformando nossos estacionamentos em hubs de serviço úteis e sustentáveis que formam elos cruciais na corrente de mobilidade urbana. Sem estacionamento, não há mobilidade, e, sem mobilidade, não há desenvolvimento. Porém, esse desenvolvimento precisa estar de acordo com o desejo das pessoas: menos estresse, ruídos, poluição e trânsito.

Por isso,“criar espaços para uma cidade tranquila em movimento” é o que fazemos na Indigo. Esse é o nosso propósito. É para isso que trabalhamos diariamente.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMER - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Pipeline Developer to join the Special Projects team to help us improve efficiency and build scalable creative production tool sets around UE. This role will have a particular focus on building out Machine Learning, AI, and Cloud-Based workflows and infrastructure to support emerging creative experiences. This is an exciting moment for technology and for creators, and the role offers the opportunity to participate in the building of vital systems that bind the engine with cloud and AI. We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about supporting teams and developing tools and workflows across one or more disciplines, are excited about emerging technology, and designing systems to help that technology be harnessed by creators. They should be able to communicate with various departments and teams to ensure that any pipeline we build is done so in close collaboration with the many other talented teams at Epic Games across the organization. Candidates should have a strong understanding of production needs and artist workflows - this role requires a clear understanding of how technology can be used to craft creative experiences, and successful candidates should have a passion for building tools for creators.

In this role, you will

  • Build best-in-class production workflow tooling and automation
  • Scope out and drive production programming initiatives, working closely with other developers and stakeholders toward scalable, maintainable solutions
  • Deliver practical, forward-thinking solutions that address the needs of the team while working with production to balance development priorities and timelines
  • Promote and demonstrate development progress to relevant stakeholders
  • Exhibit a passion for learning and staying current with emerging machine learning technology and developments

What we're looking for

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science/Programming, or relevant industry experience, with a strong foundation in software design patterns and object-oriented programming
  • 5+ years experience as a Pipeline Developer, Technical Artist, or similar, working on production in games, feature animation, VFX, or related industry
  • Experience integrating and maintaining custom tools in 3rd-party software ( eg, with Python )
  • Familiarity with current & emerging ML technologies and development environments, and demonstrable experience in building and/or experimenting in the space
  • Comfort level in working with platforms such as Azure, GCP/Vertex, AWS/Bedrock, Gradio etc, and awareness of analytics and tracking platforms like Databricks & Grafana
  • High attention to detail, proactive problem solver with excellent communication skills, and an ability to multitask effectively
  • Bonus for experience in one or more of the following areas: Unreal Engine, C++, USD & OpenSource/Standards, ShotGrid/Flow Toolkit, Asset Management, Virtual Production

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. About your Team

Growth Marketing at Teachable focuses on bringing more creators to our platform by optimizing each step of the growth funnel. We embrace testing new hypotheses, fail fast and quickly apply those learnings through a very data-driven approach. We're always adapting as both our company and industry continue to evolve, while keeping the ultimate goal of connecting with and supporting creators.

What is the role?

We are looking for a strategic and data-driven Business Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for translating complex marketing and business data into actionable insights that drive our growth strategy. You will leverage your structured problem-solving approach and analytical mindset to partner within the Growth, Brand, Partnerships, Product, Data and Finance teams to develop and implement measurement frameworks, analyze performance. You will identify strategic opportunities for optimization which you’re likely to lead or advise all the way through implementation.

This position reports to the Marketing Analytics Lead and plays a crucial role in fostering a data-driven decision-making culture throughout the organization.

This position is hybrid to our São Paulo office. Although flexible, local employees tend to use our São Paulo office 1-2 times a week.
Additionally, this position will collaborate with American employees on a daily basis, so fluency in English is required.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and maintain impactful marketing dashboards using Sigma, Google Analytics, Heap, and Looker that drive business decisions
  • Analyze marketing campaigns across channels to optimize performance and allocation of resources
  • Define and track key metrics (LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, Conversion Rates) to evaluate business health
  • Design and analyze A/B tests to optimize conversion funnels and marketing effectiveness
  • Own weekly reporting processes to deliver insights to stakeholders, including executive leadership
  • Help develop and improve attribution models to better understand marketing ROI and customer journeys
  • Apply structured problem-solving to complex challenges and develop data-driven solutions
  • Identify growth opportunities through trend analysis and funnel optimization
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure quality data collection and integration
  • Translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations with implementation roadmaps

What you'll bring:

  • 2-3 years in business analysis in strategic consulting roles or 3 + years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Previous Marketing Analytics experience is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of key business metrics: LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, and Conversion Funnel metrics
  • Knowledge of digital marketing metrics, attribution models, and customer acquisition economics
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments with statistical rigor
  • Ability to structure complex problems and drive data-driven decision making
  • Excellent communication skills to translate data findings for diverse audiences
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for data modeling and analysis
  • SQL proficiency and experience with BI tools like Sigma and Power BI

title: Doctor of Science in Health Sciences Program Director
description:
Twelve-month, open-rank, tenure-track or clinical faculty position to serve as the Program Director for the developing Doctor of Science (D.Sc.) in Health Sciences program. The Program Director will take the lead in designing the curriculum, courses, and overall structure of the DSc program in consultation with the Associate Dean for the School of Rehabilitation Sciences and the Dean for the College of Health. The new D.Sc. program at Moravian University will be offered as an online program with focused in-person residency experience(s) at the institution. Thus, there is an opportunity for this position to be remote.

Preferred start date

June 2025, but an August 2025 start is negotiable.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  1. Program Director Responsibilities:
    • Develop, direct, and oversee the Doctor of Science in Health Sciences Program, ensuring alignment with institutional goals.
    • Lead program design, development, implementation, assessment, and administration.
    • Collaborate with the Program Directors of professional programs within the College of Health to promote interdisciplinary initiatives and shared resources.
    • Ensure program effectiveness through continuous curriculum assessment, faculty development, and student engagement strategies.
  2. Faculty Responsibilities:
    • Develop and teach courses within the Doctor of Science in Health Sciences program and, as applicable, across the School of Rehabilitation Sciences and College of Health.
    • Utilize expertise in online learning platforms, hybrid learning models, and andragogical strategies for adult learners.
    • Engage in team-teaching and interdisciplinary education within the School of Rehabilitation Sciences and College of Health.
    • Participate in scholarly activities, mentorship, and service to the university and profession.

Qualifications

  • Earned research doctorate (e.g., PhD, EdD, DSc) in a health-related field preferred; earned post-professional clinical doctorates will be considered.
  • Minimum of six years of full-time teaching/administrative experience in a higher education setting.
  • Evidence of successful online or hybrid teaching experience with adult learners at the university level.
  • Evidence of curriculum development.
  • Evidence of successful scholarship and a sustained scholarly agenda (tenure-track option).
  • Face-to-face teaching experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated engagement and service to the health-related field is preferred.

School, College, University & Facilities

The School of Rehabilitation Sciences houses undergraduate programs in Health Sciences (BS) and Public Health (BS or BA), and graduate programs in Athletic Training (MSAT & DAT), Occupational Therapy (MSOT & PP-OTD), Speech-Language Pathology (MS-SLP, SLPD), and Physical Therapy (DPT). The school promotes interprofessional programs within a collaborative environment designed to foster student learning and engagement across disciplines.

Moravian University features state-of-the-art facilities, including the Sports Medicine Rehabilitation Center and the Sally Breidegam Miksiewicz Center for Health Sciences, equipped with cutting-edge technology for student education.

Additional Information

Moravian University does not sponsor applicants for non-tenure track positions for a U.S. work visa.

Our mission is to prepare individuals for reflective lives and leadership in a changing world, fostering an inclusive environment that values diversity and lifelong learning.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment and do not discriminate based on protected characteristics. For more details, see our DEI Action Plan .

Work Environment

The position involves indoor work with minimal outdoor exposure and moderate noise levels. We welcome applicants of all abilities and are committed to providing accommodations during the hiring process and in the role.

Application Process

Qualified candidates should submit their cover letter and curriculum vitae as PDF files through our online application portal. For questions, contact Louise Keegan at .

Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. All positions are contingent on budget availability.

RAPP Dallas is looking for an Enterprise Architect to join our award-winning Technology team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As aglobal, next-generation precision marketing agencywe leveragedata, creativity, technology, and empathyto foster client growth.We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

As the Enterprise Architect you will lead and oversee the architecture practice for your client portfolio, managing a multi-disciplinary team responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining multi-functional technology solutions. This role will drive architectural vision, establish technical standards, and ensure alignment between business strategy and technology initiatives while maintaining operational excellence across all platforms.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and mentor a diverse architecture team, including management of offshore resources
  • Develop and maintain enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, and governance processes
  • Design and oversee implementation of high-availability cloud-based solutions
  • Create and maintain enterprise-wide architecture documentation, including data models, system diagrams, and integration patterns
  • Guide technical decision-making for new features and platform enhancements
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives
  • Manage existing platform operations while driving innovation and modernization initiatives
  • Establish and monitor architecture KPIs and success metrics
  • Provide technical leadership in evaluating new technologies and platforms

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 15+ years of technology experience with 8+ years in enterprise architecture roles
  • Proven experience leading architecture teams and managing offshore resources
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native architectures
  • Strong background in high-availability system design and implementation
  • Experience with enterprise integration patterns and microservices architecture
  • Demonstrated ability in creating and maintaining architecture artifacts and documentation
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, information design, and security principles
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Experience with agile methodologies and DevOps practices
  • Track record of successful enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives

EDUCATION AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field; Master's preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in technology management or execution role
  • Experience in at least one major Cloud Platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Relevant experience with Integration Technologies (e.g. APIs, ESBs, Message Queues)
  • Knowledge of at least one modeling/diagraming tool: Visio or equivalent
  • Salesforce or Adobe Campaign experience preferred

Our Hybrid Work Model:

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

RAPP provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Healthcare & Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts, vacation, sick, and personal days and positive activism days, paid parental leave and disability benefits. For more information regarding Omnicom benefits, please visit . A reasonable estimate of the salary for this role, at the time of posting, is $128,000 - $153,000. Negociar ações de trade, fazendo gestão de preço de venda ao consumidor. Garantir a perfeita execução dos ativos e comunicação visual.

Principais atribuições

  1. Desenvolver o relacionamento sólido e de confiança através de propostas comerciais claras, eficazes e transparentes, bem como por meio do acompanhamento de todo o ciclo de venda (contatos com o PDV, negociações, captura de pedidos acurada, títulos em aberto, ações de trade, relacionamento entre as áreas envolvidas negociados, entre outras ações que envolvam esse processo).

  3. Garantir a acuracidade de dados cadastrais de sua carteira de clientes, solicitando ajustes somente que estiverem em compliance com as diretrizes da empresa.
  4. Executar processos de pesquisa quando solicitado, se comprometendo a seguir diretrizes de compliance.
  5. Elaborar um planejamento de vendas mensal e semanal, analisando perfil e histórico de vendas do PDV.
  6. Realizar visitas (atendimento) em todos os pontos de venda de sua base de atendimento diário de acordo com a roteirização estabelecida pela área técnica, executando a rotina básica do vendedor dentro do ponto de venda, visando vendas assertivas de acordo com a FDS para o atingimento das metas.
  7. Fazer gestão de ativos da base de clientes, com foco no atingimento das metas.
  8. Estar conectado com as estratégias da empresa.
  9. Negociar ações de trade, fazendo gestão de preço de venda ao consumidor.
  10. Prospectar novos PDVs.
  11. Zelar por toda e quaisquer ferramentas de trabalho fornecidas pela empresa, garantindo correto manuseio e manutenção, conforme diretrizes estabelecidas pela Cia.

Ensino médio completo.

Para te ajudar nas compras no mercado temos o Vale Alimentação mensal e para sua alimentação diária temos o Vale Refeição ou Refeitório .

title: Lead Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Lead Concept Artist to help us continue shaping the future of Fortnite. We are searching for an experienced artist to support and supervise creative content provided by artists. Reporting to the individual art team director and working with the Outsource Manager, the Lead Concept Artist will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Epic review. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, we are looking for an experienced Concept Artist with a solid hands-on art background who has worked in game studio pipelines before. The ideal candidate would be a talented artist who is able to communicate with artists, including documenting existing pipelines, collecting or creating quality bar and technical example assets, collecting photo references, creating mood boards, creating paint overs, and finally collaborating with other teams at Epic to ensure that concept art is of the highest quality and adequately supports the needs of those teams and the project.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the individual Art Leads, Art Directors, and Outsource Manager(s) on the team to support internal artists
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the artists
  • If required, make any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready
  • Clearly communicate feedback to the artists, and ensure those creative notes and goals are met, and inform leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicate and partner with internal Epic art staff to ensure that concept art is clear and respects limitations from other disciplines
  • When required, some amount of hands-on art production to deliver concepts for the project, ensuring they are familiar and capable working alongside other Epic artists

What we're looking for

  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Senior/Lead Concept Artist role
  • Experience working with intellectual properties
  • A portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity, and craftsmanship
  • Effective communicator, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate between internal and external teams and deliver clear and concise feedback
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Understanding of other game art disciplines, their workflows, and limitations (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do
  • A PLUS - Fluency in a language other than English, including Chinese, German, Spanish, Italian, or Russian

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

We offer:

  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join oursustainable business practicesfocused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a talented and passionate Data Engineer – Generalist to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll leverage modern technologies to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines while contributing to organizational best practices. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and have a knack for innovative problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Data Engineering team lead in ensuring quality and agility across team activities.
  • Collaborating with fellow data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using leading-edge technologies.
  • Building and maintaining data pipelines that integrate diverse data sources into a Harmonized Data Mesh for both internal and external use.
  • Debugging, unit testing, and deploying data pipelines while optimizing their performance.
  • Managing metadata associated with data and processes to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Documenting and versioning code to maintain transparency and scalability.
  • Promoting Data Engineering best practices and contributing to Enterprise Data Governance frameworks.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, high-quality engineering solutions that meet evolving business needs.
  • Driving continuous improvement in test development, automation, and release processes.
  • Advocating for user-centric design and functionality when collaborating with product, design, and technical teams.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience:
  • Relevant experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms, preferably Azure.
  • Proficiency in modern data storage systems (e.g., Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse).
  • Expertise in developing data pipelines using PySpark, Scala, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience working with Big Data platforms, such as Databricks.
  • Advanced knowledge of relational/transactional databases and SQL.
  • Strong skills in performance tuning for PySpark and SQL workflows.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Skills:
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to diverse audiences.
  • Passion for innovation and collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mindset:
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Creative thinker who enjoys solving complex problems.
  • Team-oriented and adaptable to shifting priorities.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, innovative team shaping the future of data engineering in ABI.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies.
  • A supportive culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Data Scientist. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate, test, and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people do not just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for career progression. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do, we live our values:

  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive modeling applied to industrial operations. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for constructing models to solve business problems, communicating with technical teams, and ensuring delivery aligns with business expectations. You will also work with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, create, test, and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions across the organization.
  • Provide technical support for data scientists across multiple squads.
  • Collaborate with business analysts to understand problems and implement scalable solutions.
  • Define development standards and solution approaches.
  • Design and structure reusable codebases.
  • Coordinate with MIS, Digital Specialists, and Data Engineers to deliver comprehensive analytical solutions.
  • Communicate the design, functioning, and output of analytical models/solutions.
  • Ensure timely analysis and testing for maintenance of solutions.
  • Present data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

  • Make decisions aligned with Bunge’s strategy, business needs, and financial goals, exploring new perspectives through innovation.
  • Build strong relationships, influence others, and develop talent.
  • Develop data-driven strategies aligned with company priorities and communicate effectively.
  • Proficient in data science, machine learning, programming languages like Python or R, SQL, data analysis, teamwork, and communication skills.
  • Assist in structuring problems/hypotheses and translating them into advanced analytics approaches, including machine learning and optimization.
  • Help business understand data science and optimization concepts for better cross-functional communication.

Education/Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in mathematics, analytics, and computer science, including machine learning, statistical models, and data science programming.
  • Avoid logical flaws, build resilient data pipelines in cloud environments, and prepare high-quality data.
  • Mentor associates and data scientists, and communicate effectively with stakeholders and management.
  • Model behavior as a team player and foster new ideas.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a global leader in sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s network supports over 70,000 farmers and consumers worldwide, with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, and 25,000 employees globally, operating numerous facilities and terminals.

Bunge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, or veteran status. Minorities, women, veterans, and disabled persons are encouraged to apply.

Technical Information:

About AB InBev:

AB InBev is the global beer leader and one of the top 5 consumer products companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, they are number one or two in many of the world's major beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About Bees: We are part of the ABInBev ecosystem, the world's largest brewery, and we work to help our customers using a variety of BEES Applications. As a technological cell of our organization, we have a simple goal: to grow. To grow as people, as professionals, as a company. To achieve this, we use technology to create digital solutions that simplify our customers' lives, make their decisions smarter, and their businesses more profitable.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and lead a high-performance team of data analysts, being a technical reference, providing guidance, mentoring, and support for the analysis team.
  • Manage a team of approximately 5 to 10 resources, depending on project allocation.
  • Review to verify that best practices have been followed for high-quality products, recommend appropriate data sources, models, and methods that may apply to a specific use case, ensuring scalability and high reuse.
  • Work with product leaders, engineering, and commercial strategy to form a unified data-driven strategy.
  • Support the prioritization exercise in analysis requests for your team alongside stakeholders and DPMs (data product managers), based on business impact, level of effort, etc.
  • Actively balance team leadership efforts with practical development/coding of data products, metrics, and visualizations to drive business.
  • Drive the business strategy by providing insights into current performance and highlighting areas of opportunity for growth. To do this, conduct advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning models to answer specific business questions, extract insights and predictive patterns from large datasets to explain and expose potential opportunities from the data.
  • Develop data sets/schemas consuming data from multiple sources such as internal databases, analysis tools, unstructured sources, and other external sources.
  • Produce effective data narratives to drive action on these opportunities by designing and developing data visualizations using PowerBI.
  • Ensure the use of appropriate analytical methods to solve complex business problems.
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of complex data models, data structures, and best practices for data governance to support the data platform team in definitions and executions following best practices appropriate to use cases.
  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and analytical insights to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Degree in Information Systems, Data Science and Analytics, or related course.
  • Prior experience in technical management of Data Analyst teams. Extensive experience in data analysis, data science.
  • Advanced English is mandatory - will work with a global team. Other languages will be considered a differential.
  • Prior experience in cloud solutions such as Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or Teradata.
  • Expertise in database query and reporting tools (SQL + Power BI + DAX). Tableau & Mode will be considered a differential.
  • Effective skills in programming languages (Python, PySpark, SQL).
  • Experience in using SQL/NOSQL databases. "R" is considered a differential.
  • Strong skills in analysis, problem-solving, conceptual thinking, and a solid background in statistical analysis focused on data-driven solutions.
  • Experience in gathering complex business requirements and identifying data needs.
  • Experience in analyzing data to identify key insights, gaps, and inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with the Systems Development Life Cycle and Agile Methodology.
  • Experience in leveraging transactional and digital behavioral data to understand business impacts and user behavior as input for ROI.

Soft Skills:

  • Promote collaboration and a productive work environment by sharing knowledge and experience with direct subordinates.
  • Excellent leadership, team management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with multifunctional teams and present complex ideas to non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to seek unconventional solutions, explore opportunities, and develop innovative solutions.

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

title: Corpo humano revela fatos tão bizarros que até cientistas duvidam
description:
Corpo humano revela fatos tão bizarros que até cientistas duvidam

O corpo humano é uma verdadeira máquina complexa e fascinante, cheia de mistérios que até mesmo cientistas admitem serem surpreendentes ou bizarros. Conhecer fatos sobre o corpo humano que até cientistas acham bizarros pode ampliar nossa percepção sobre a incrível capacidade do organismo, revelando curiosidades que desafiam o senso comum e a lógica aparente. Neste artigo, vamos explorar esses fatos incríveis que fazem parte do funcionamento do corpo humano, explicando de forma clara e acessível por que eles impressionam até os especialistas. Prepare-se para descobrir informações que vão muito além do que você imagina sobre seu próprio corpo.

O que torna o corpo humano tão surpreendente para a ciência?

O corpo humano é formado por trilhões de células que trabalham em conjunto de maneira coordenada, mas nem sempre essa complexidade é completamente compreendida. A ciência continua descobrindo fenômenos únicos, como a capacidade do cérebro de criar memórias falsas ou o fato de que o estômago produz um ácido capaz de corroer metais. Esses fatos sobre o corpo humano que até cientistas acham bizarros revelam que nosso organismo é muito mais estranho e poderoso do que aparenta. Além disso, o corpo humano possui adaptações evolutivas curiosas e mecanismos internos que desafiam explicações simples, como a capacidade de autorregeneração e a existência de sensações inexplicáveis, como arrepios sem estímulo externo. Isso mostra que, mesmo com todos os avanços científicos, o corpo continua sendo uma fonte inesgotável de descobertas

Quais são os fatos mais bizarros sobre o corpo humano que surpreendem os cientistas?

Entre os fatos mais estranhos, está o fato de que o corpo produz cerca de 25 milhões de células por segundo para substituir as que morrem, o que mostra um nível de renovação constante. Outro ponto curioso é que o ser humano possui uma bactéria em seu intestino chamada Escherichia coli que ajuda na digestão, mas pode ser mortal em grandes quantidades, indicando uma relação de equilíbrio delicada. Além disso, há o fenômeno da síncope vasovagal, quando uma pessoa desmaia ao ver sangue ou passar por um estresse emocional forte — uma reação surpreendente para muitos que desafia a lógica direta de “fugir do perigo”. Esses fatos e muitos outros revelam que o corpo humano possui reações e características difíceis até para os próprios cientistas entenderem completamente.

Por que o cérebro humano é considerado uma das partes mais bizarras do corpo?

O cérebro, órgão central do sistema nervoso, tem propriedades que desafiam a compreensão total até dos neurocientistas mais experientes. Ele é responsável por funções cognitivas complexas, como raciocínio, emoções e memória, mas também pode pregar peças, criando ilusões, falsas memórias e até mesmo alucinações. Um fato bizarro é que o cérebro não sente dor, apesar de controlar as sensações de dor pelo corpo. Isso explica como cirurgias cerebrais podem ser feitas com o paciente consciente. Além disso, o cérebro é capaz de reorganizar suas conexões após lesões, um fenômeno chamado neuroplasticidade, que ainda intriga a comunidade científica por sua complexidade e potencial.
