Como o corpo humano lida com microrganismos de forma tão estranha?

O corpo humano é lar de trilhões de microrganismos que vivem em simbiose, principalmente na pele e no intestino. Essa relação é tão complexa que o corpo depende dessas bactérias para funções vitais, como a digestão e a produção de vitaminas. O estranho é que, em certas situações, microrganismos benignos podem se transformar em ameaças, causando doenças inesperadas. Outro fato curioso é o sistema imunológico, que é capaz de “memorizar” invasores e reagir com maior eficiência em novas infecções, mas que às vezes reage de forma exagerada a estímulos inofensivos, como no caso das alergias. Essa dualidade entre proteção e ataque faz do sistema imunológico um dos aspectos mais intrigantes do corpo humano.

O que faz o sistema circulatório ser tão impressionante e, às vezes, bizarro?

O sistema circulatório humano move cerca de 5 litros de sangue pelo corpo a cada minuto, mas o que impressiona é que essa rede de vasos sanguíneos, se colocada em linha reta, teria aproximadamente 100 mil quilômetros — quase três voltas ao redor da Terra. Essa complexidade permite que cada célula receba nutrientes e oxigênio, mas também é palco de fenômenos inusitados. Por exemplo, o corpo pode ajustar a pressão arterial automaticamente conforme o ambiente, mesmo que a pessoa esteja em repouso. Além disso, o sangue pode se comportar de maneiras surpreendentes, como mudar sua viscosidade em resposta a diferentes condições, algo que nem sempre é intuitivo para a maioria das pessoas.

Quais são as curiosidades mais bizarras relacionadas à pele humana?

A pele, maior órgão do corpo, é uma barreira viva que protege contra agentes externos, regula a temperatura e transmite sensações. Um fato bizarro é que a pele humana renova completamente sua camada externa a cada 27 dias, e que perdemos cerca de 30 mil células mortas por minuto. Outro aspecto curioso é a capacidade da pele de produzir vitamina D quando exposta ao sol, mas que ao mesmo tempo pode desenvolver reações estranhas, como coceira ou erupções inexplicáveis. Além disso, existem casos raros em que pessoas apresentam pelos em locais incomuns ou em excesso, fenômeno chamado hirsutismo, que desafia a explicação simplista sobre genética e hormônios.

O corpo humano é uma fonte infinita de mistérios e aprendizados

Fatos sobre o corpo humano que até cientistas acham bizarros nos mostram que, apesar dos avanços da ciência, nosso organismo continua sendo um território de enigmas. O funcionamento complexo e, por vezes, contraditório do corpo revela que há muito a descobrir, entender e respeitar sobre essa estrutura viva que nos mantém ativos e conscientes. Conhecer essas curiosidades é um convite para valorizar mais o corpo e a saúde, reconhecendo sua capacidade surpreendente de adaptação e transformação. Afinal, cada detalhe bizarro é parte do equilíbrio que mantém nossa vida em constante movimento.

description:
Global Payroll Compliance and Excellence Specialist

Do you know Bunge?

Distributed in more than 40 countries, a world leader in oilseed processing and one of the largest producers and suppliers of vegetable oils, fats, and proteins for more than two centuries, Bunge works to connect farmers to consumers to provide essential food, ingredients, and fuels for the world. With 117 years in Brazil, we have more than 100 units and are one of the main agribusiness and food companies, a leader in grain origination and soybean and wheat processing. In all our value chains, we promote our business while supporting the social and economic well-being of the communities where we operate.

We value the diversity of our teams and seek creative talents with team spirit and a desire to make a difference. In everything we do, we put our values into practice:
• Act as one team, promoting inclusion, collaboration, and respect;
• Seek excellence, being agile, innovative, and efficient;
• Do what is right, acting in a safe, ethical, and sustainable manner.

At Bunge, we value diversity in all its forms and work towards an inclusive and belonging culture with respect and equity. Here, everyone is welcome as they are!

Our company has a solid track record, and we are building a future full of opportunities! Be part of our team and follow your professional journey with us.

Role Purpose

Global Payroll Compliance and Excellence Manager is responsible for providing strategic direction and support on global payroll for approximately 23,000 employees in 44 countries across the globe (Asia, Americas, and Europe). This role is responsible for ensuring, in partnership with HR regional leaders and BBS, accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll processing across all regions, managing payroll policies, and enhancing payroll systems and processes. This manager will work closely with cross-functional teams and regional payroll teams to implement and support on global standards processes, maintain compliance with varying regulations, and drive continuous improvement within payroll operations and T&A harmonization/standardization. The position will also support on vendor management to ensure payroll accuracy and compliance in multiple countries

Main Accountabilities

  • Support developing and implementing global payroll strategies, policies, and best practices to ensure efficient, timely, accurate and compliant payroll operations.
  • Support Global Payroll Transformation and M&A´s integration.
  • Support Time & Absence Transformation.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track payroll accuracy, efficiency and compliance, including payroll and tax reconciliation, identifying and recommending opportunities to improve tax-related processes and systems to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with international, federal, state, and local payroll regulations, including tax filings, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Implement controls to mitigate risks associated with payroll processing, including data integrity, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner with internal and external auditors to address audit requirements and resolve any compliance issues.
  • Facilitate training and communication with regional payroll teams on policies, processes, and changes in payroll regulations.
  • Partner with HR global functions to build and implement global processes, e.g. payroll mobility control, salary publishing, bonus publishing and respective activities transition to BBS.
  • Establish partnerships with third party vendors to ensure effective service delivery, and support HR regional leaders on manage them

Knowledge and Skills

  • Make decisions aligned to Bunge’s global strategy, business needs and financial goals and explore new perspectives by driving innovation.
  • Cultivate strong relationships and networks, effectively influence others, and develop talent to excel in their current and future roles.
  • Develop data driven strategies aligned with Bunge’s priorities, energize others to action through clear and compelling communication.
  • Clear understanding of HR operational excellence, global payroll, organizational alignment
  • Strong communications and presentation skills, the ability to make the complex, detailed information clear and actionable, as well as strong influence management skills to the alignment and commitment
  • Excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution capability
  • Experience driving projects to a successful completion, and ability to work in a global environment
  • HR operations and payroll best practices and processes knowledge
  • Knowledge of labor legislation overall
  • GDPR (data privacy) knowledge

Education & Experience

  • Degree in business management, Human Resources or related discipline in an equivalent education
  • Experience with HR Operations, payroll and/or any other HR role
  • Experience with end-to-end M&A activities
  • Experience managing large vendors and contracts
  • Focus on customer service
  • Excellent written communication and numerical skills
  • Ability to work within tight and conflicting timeframes
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance and driving results
  • Ability to handle confidential information and sensitive matters
  • Fluent English language skill (Spanish is desired)

The Lead Generation Specialist for Brazil, reporting to the Associate Director of Commercial Operations, will focus primarily on the entire BIDs process, since capture of "editais" until, will prepare all the documentation to participate on the BID process, and participate in the BID session. After the BID, this person needs to follow the process until we receive the Purchase Order.   • Identify new end users within existing customer accounts to increase sales opportunities.
  • Generate lists of qualified target prospects for outbound marketing campaigns.
  • Maintain information within lead databases and customer relationship management (CRM) platform.
  • Develop and execute strategies to reach out to potential customers and collaborate with the sales and commercial development teams to create effective lead generation campaigns and streamlined customer communication plans.
  • Evaluate prospect’s needs and goals prior to handing leads off to the sales team.
  • Track and report on lead generation performance metrics and continuously refine your approach to optimize results.

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience in bidding process is required.
  • Experience in lead generation/prospecting in genomics, life sciences, pharma, medical device or related fields preferred.
  • Knowledge of genetics, genomics, bioinformatics and related applications and techniques (eg. PCR, NGS) and knowledge of related market in Brazil.
  • Ability to conduct market research for targeted leads.
  • Highly self-motivated, adaptable, independent individual who is a quick learner, with excellent project management skills and attention to detail.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to work as a team player in a dynamic, fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experience with CRM (Salesforce) and lead nurturing strategies preferred but not required.

title: Especialista de Torre de Controle, First Mile
description:
The First Mile team is looking for an SPC Shift Manager to join our Seller Processing Center in Osasco, SP.
Are you ready to work hard, have fun and make history? If so, Amazon may be the right place for you. Our logistics teams are redefining the way we serve customers across the globe, solving some of the most complex challenges in the industry.
Amazon’s transportation network ensures packages are delivered efficiently and reliably, whether the items are large or small. As an SPC Shift Manager, you will be responsible for leading operations within a Seller Processing Center. You will manage Team Leads, Operators and Delivery Service Providers, as well as oversee the performance and relationships with external staffing partners.
This role requires flexibility, leadership and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, startup-like environment. We value bold ideas, test and learn approaches, and continuous improvement.
If you are customer-obsessed, thrive in dynamic environments and have experience in high-performance operations, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Being based at one of our Seller Processing Centers (SPCs), working day and night shifts. Amazon operates 24/7, so this role includes shift work, which may involve weekends and holidays.
- Overseeing operations focused on the pickup of Amazon orders from sellers and ensuring they are sent to last mile stations for customer delivery.
- Supporting a team of operational leaders in the daily management of the SPC, including labor allocation, leading shift meetings, assigning tasks, and coordinating with internal and external partners.
- Managing key performance indicators (KPIs) such as On-Time Dispatch and First Day Pickup Success, while continuously improving the customer experience.
- Applying strong analytical and project management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to influence stakeholders.
- Being metrics-driven, investigating root causes quickly and using data to drive process improvements.
- Solving complex problems with practical, scalable solutions—without compromising quality or core functionality.
- Using excellent problem-solving and communication skills to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Supporting the implementation of new systems and processes, providing hands-on support and collecting feedback for improvements.
- Mapping business requirements, analyzing workflows, and designing operational solutions.
- Leveraging software and hardware tools to ensure seamless daily operations, while ensuring associates have the necessary tools and coordinating repairs or replacements as needed.
- Reporting daily metrics and operational exceptions to internal teams and relevant departments across Amazon.
- Maintaining flexibility to work a variety of schedules based on business needs, including overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Employee and performance management experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience.

  • Experiência em arquitetura de sistemas complexos e desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos;
  • Sólida experiência com frameworks de frontend modernos como React, Angular, ou Vue.js, e profunda compreensão dos padrões de arquitetura de frontend, como componentização, gerenciamento de estado, e otimização de performance em aplicações web;

  • Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de produto e negócios, garantindo que as direções técnicas estejam sempre alinhadas com as necessidades estratégicas da empresa;

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description
Infopulse, part of Tietoevry Create, is inviting talented professionals to join our project as a Network Support Engineer for our respected client in the telecommunications field.
About The Client
Arelion, a leading IP services provider, recognized for its vast global network and 100% organically grown fiber backbone. They offer dedicated internet access, IP addresses, cloud connect, ethernet services, and optical fiber solutions to sectors like financial services, government, and gaming, ensuring reliability and scalability for major brands. Established in the early 1990s, Arelion, formerly Telia Carrier, has become the preferred connectivity partner for top content providers and enterprises. The network spans 70,000 km across Europe, North America, and Asia, serving over 2,300 wholesale customers in more than 125 countries.
About The Role
Network Support Engineer will be responsible for monitoring network performance, both transmission and IP, as well as the underlying infrastructure. You will act on alarms and troubleshoot issues, including incidents reported by customers. Collaborating with third-party providers, you will perform in-depth troubleshooting and coordinate joint efforts to resolve incidents. Descrição da vaga
No mercado desde 1999, a ORIZON VALORIZAÇÃO DE RESÍDUOS S.A., é referência pelo pioneirismo e por oferecer uma linha completa de soluções integradas de gestão e beneficiamento de resíduos, que vão desde a reciclagem até a geração de biogás, biometano e energia elétrica. Seus ecoparques atuam como a última barreira protetora do meio ambiente, reduzindo a emissão de gás carbônico, tratando resíduos com potencial de reaproveitamento pela indústria, e garantindo que o lixo – material que não pode ser reutilizado – seja destinado de forma ambientalmente adequada, evitando a contaminação de solos, rios, mares e ar. Com o Propósito de Proporcionar sustentabilidade na relação entre humanos e meio ambiente, inovando em soluções de gestão de resíduos gerados pela sociedade, buscamos um profissional alinhado à nossa cultura para integrar o time de engenharia de biometano da Orizon VR.
Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Projetos com sólida experiência em empreendimentos Greenfield para liderar projetos estratégicos de implantação de plantas de biometano nos ecoparques da Orizon VR. Este profissional será responsável por todo o ciclo de vida do projeto , desde a concepção e viabilidade técnico-econômica até o comissionamento, start-up e entrega operacional da planta.
Com reporte à Diretoria de Engenharia e Energia, o Gerente será o elo entre áreas técnicas, regulatórias, jurídicas, suprimentos, meio ambiente e diretoria executiva, garantindo excelência na execução e alinhamento às diretrizes ESG, compliance e metas corporativas.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Gestão de Projetos Greenfield

  • Liderar o ciclo completo de projetos Greenfield de plantas de biometano: concepção, pré-viabilidade, viabilidade, engenharia conceitual, básica e detalhada, licenciamento, implantação, comissionamento e operação assistida.
  • Estruturar cronogramas físico-financeiros detalhados, assegurando o cumprimento rigoroso de prazos, custos e escopo.
  • Gerenciar escopo técnico multidisciplinar (civil, eletromecânico, automação, processos, ambiental), contratando e coordenando fornecedores, projetistas e integradores.
Governança e Integração Executiva
  • Conduzir os ritos de governança comitês técnicos e de investimento, promovendo gestão baseada em dados e tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Reportar o andamento dos projetos à Diretoria e aos Conselhos, elaborando relatórios de progresso, riscos e viabilidade.
  • Implantar práticas de gestão de projetos com base em FEL, PMBOK, MoP e ESG, alinhando estratégias institucionais à execução técnica.
Licenciamento e Interface Regulatória
  • Coordenar o licenciamento ambiental, energético e fundiário junto a órgãos como ANP, ANEEL, IBAMA, CETESB, prefeituras e concessionárias.
  • Supervisionar processos de regularização e due diligence técnica e jurídica para viabilização dos projetos.
  • Assegurar compliance com normas ambientais, sanitárias, urbanísticas e energéticas.
Controle e Performance
  • Utilizar MS Project, Excel avançado e Power BI para o controle de cronogramas, CAPEX, indicadores de performance (KPIs), riscos e qualidade.
  • Realizar análise de viabilidade econômico-financeira, monitorando payback, TIR, VPL e custos operacionais esperados.
  • Liderar auditorias internas e externas de engenharia e compliance regulatório.
Liderança e Cultura Técnica
  • Coordenar equipes próprias e contratadas com foco em performance, segurança e inovação.
  • Fomentar a cultura de excelência, conformidade e engenharia de valor, promovendo treinamentos e rituais de aprendizado contínuo.
  • Articular o conhecimento entre diferentes áreas da empresa, garantindo sinergia e alinhamento estratégico.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação Acadêmica
  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Elétrica, Mecânica, Civil, Química, de Energia ou Produção).
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou mestrado em áreas como Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia de Processos, Energia Renovável, ou Planejamento Estratégico.
Experiência e Conhecimentos Técnicos
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na gestão de projetos industriais Greenfield, preferencialmente em energia, gás, resíduos, O&G ou infraestrutura.
  • Domínio de metodologias como FEL, PMBOK, P3O e Agile, além de gestão de portfólio e análise de risco integrada.
  • Vivência comprovada com licenciamento ambiental e atuação junto a órgãos reguladores (ANP, ANEEL, IBAMA, etc.).
  • Conhecimento técnico em processos de produção e purificação de biogás e biometano será considerado diferencial estratégico.
Ferramentas e Sistemas
  • Excel avançado com modelagem financeira e simuladores.
  • MS Project, Power BI, ERP SAP (PS/MM/CO) ou TOTVS.
  • Ferramentas de gerenciamento de risco, compliance e due diligence (ex: MetricStream, Conformity, etc.).
Certificações Desejáveis
  • PMP (PMI), MoP, Prince2, FEL, Six Sigma, Lean Construction.
  • Certificações em Governança (IBGC), ESG ou Gestão Ambiental.
Idiomas
  • Inglês avançado (leitura técnica, comunicação com fornecedores globais, apresentações executivas).
Habilidades Comportamentais
  • Visão estratégica e orientação a resultados.
  • Alta capacidade de articulação entre áreas e stakeholders.
  • Espírito de liderança, habilidade de negociação e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Compromisso com a cultura de segurança, inovação e sustentabilidade.
Condições de Trabalho
  • Atuação estratégica e presencial em São Paulo, com viagens frequentes às unidades operacionais e obras.
  • Participação em reuniões com órgãos reguladores, stakeholders externos e conselhos.
  • Exposição eventual a ambientes industriais com riscos ambientais e ergonômicos, conforme PGR.
Treinamentos Obrigatórios
  • Capacitação em Gestão Estratégica de Projetos Greenfield.
  • Treinamentos em Governança, ESG e Compliance Regulatória.
  • Metodologias Ágeis e Engenharia de Processos Sustentáveis.

title: Software Developer Engineer II, Intech
description:
Amazon.com's long-term vision is to enable a seamless global shopping experience for all Amazon customers worldwide on any Amazon website or device, in any language and for any culture. Our goal is to create software that offers customers a unique shopping experience that is internationalized for their preferences.
Our team is responsible for automating the launch strategy for Amazon's expansion into new countries. We build customer-facing features in a highly distributed environment that directly impacts Amazon’s e-commerce revenue in over 150+ countries.
About you:
You're looking for a career where you'll be able to build, to deliver, and to impress. You build customer facing features that reach millions of new customers all over the world. You look at problems holistically, and thrive on the intricate complexity of designing feedback loops and ecosystems. You want to work on projects where you are leveraging Machine Learning models to implement solutions to real problems that require creative and deep understanding of the problem space. You challenge yourself and others to constantly come up with better solutions. You work closely with the business to define the expansion strategy and figure out innovative solutions to help this thriving business continue its exponential growth.
About us together:
We're going to eliminate vendor complexity so they can make products available in any market place. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make tough decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team.
The ideal engineer for this space will be highly quantitative, have great judgment and passion for building a great customer experience, be inventive, and have a strong track record of delivery. You also have a pragmatic approach and iterative approach to building software: you have an ability to simplify and get things done with a demonstrated track record of building and delivering software and working effectively with external and internal teams.
Questions?
You may already know if you're a fit, but perhaps you're worried about technology and experience requirements? Don't be - we're looking for smart, proven, engineers; if you're the right candidate, we're flexible.
Key job responsibilities
As an SDE II, you’ll contribute to your team’s software, delivering features that span its life cycle. This includes working with your team to design solutions that enhance existing features and enable new ones. You’ll exercise autonomy and make trade-offs between feature development and operational work.
You’ll also document your team’s software, including how it’s constructed, tested, operated, and secured, and how it fits into the bigger picture. You’ll train team members on these points and work alongside customers, stakeholders, and peers to ensure your solutions deliver real value.
We’re committed to developing our people, and as an SDE II, you’ll mentor and guide others. You’ll also play a role in recruiting and interviewing for your team.
About the team
INTech LatAm's mission is to create technology to enable sustainable growth for Amazon Stores across Latin America, through products, experiments, and solutions that solve local problems for customers and seller partners on a global scale.
We are a product, technology, and data science organization with nearly 400 engineers, organized into 40+ cross-functional teams across five divisions: Global Invoicing Services, Shopping, FBA, Supply Chain & Fulfillment, and Machine Learning. We own over 150 services (20 tier-1) that support the operations of Amazon Stores in 17+ countries. Since then, we've launched over 250 initiatives, creating new systems and solutions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Unique opportunity to coordinate a high-performance team, manage complex cases with significant clients, and have relationships with insurance companies and regulators.

Advanced English desirable;

Experience with Property, Engineering and Credit Claims;

Experience to lead with insurance, adjusters and/or Brokers;

Experience with people management.

title: Gerente de Hotel
description:
Gerente de Hotel é responsável por garantir a operação eficiente e lucrativa do hotel, liderando as equipes, otimizando os processos internos e proporcionando uma experiência excepcional aos hóspedes. Sua função abrange a gestão das operações diárias, a supervisão das áreas de atendimento, vendas e finanças, e o desenvolvimento de estratégias que alinhem os objetivos do hotel às expectativas dos clientes e às metas financeiras.

Requisitos do Cargo:

Formação Acadêmica:

  1. Graduação em Gestão de Hospedagem, Administração, Turismo, ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas, como Gestão Hoteleira, Gestão Financeira ou Marketing, é um diferencial.

Experiência Profissional:

  1. Experiência de pelo menos 2 anos em cargos de liderança.

1. Gestão Operacional:

  1. Supervisionar as operações diárias do hotel, garantindo que todos os departamentos (recepção, serviços de alimentação, limpeza, manutenção, entre outros) funcionem de maneira integrada.
  2. Implementar e monitorar os padrões de qualidade e os processos operacionais, garantindo a excelência no serviço e a satisfação dos hóspedes.
  3. Gerenciar o fluxo de hóspedes, coordenando reservas, check-ins e check-outs, e garantindo a ocupação ideal do hotel.
  4. Monitorar a limpeza, manutenção e segurança das instalações, coordenando com as equipes responsáveis.

2. Gestão de Equipe:

  1. Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe do hotel, assegurando que todos os membros do staff compreendam suas funções e ofereçam atendimento de alta qualidade.
  2. Realizar recrutamento e seleção de funcionários, acompanhando o desempenho e promovendo programas de desenvolvimento profissional.
  3. Resolver conflitos internos e promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e colaborativo.

3. Gestão Financeira:

  1. Controlar e monitorar o orçamento do hotel, incluindo custos operacionais.
  2. Desenvolver estratégias para otimizar a receita, como promoções, pacotes especiais e parcerias comerciais.

4. Atendimento ao Cliente:

  1. Garantir que as necessidades dos hóspedes sejam atendidas de maneira eficiente e personalizada.
  2. Monitorar a satisfação dos hóspedes através de pesquisas de opinião e feedback direto.
  3. Resolver reclamações ou problemas de hóspedes de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a fidelização.

5. Marketing e Vendas:

  1. Desenvolver estratégias de marketing para promover o hotel e aumentar a taxa de ocupação, trabalhando com o departamento de vendas e marketing.
  2. Estabelecer parcerias com agências de viagens.
  3. Participar da criação de pacotes promocionais e oferecer pacotes.

6. Compliance e Sustentabilidade:

  1. Garantir que o hotel esteja em conformidade com as regulamentações locais de segurança, saúde e licenciamento.

description:
Critical Minerals Commercial Leader (Director Level)

Critical Minerals Commercial Leader (Director Level)

Join to apply for the Critical Minerals Commercial Leader (Director Level) role at ERM

As part of the continued growth of ERM’s mining and metals business and our position as a market leader in sustainability consulting services, ERM is seeking an experienced leader to join our thriving global consulting firm as a Critical Minerals Commercial Leader in the Latam market. This is a Partner-level opportunity with an equity stake for a Principal/Director/VP-level professional to further your career by joining our regional Mining and Metals Commercial Leadership Team in a highly visible, business-critical and dynamic leadership role with significant growth potential.
The ideal candidate will have established relationships with Argentina, Peru and/or Chile based mining and metals companies, technical expertise, and experience leading multi-disciplinary mine development and mineral processing and refining capital projects. We seek an individual who will drive the continued growth of ERM’s business by delivering world-class services, recruiting and developing our next generation of leaders, and advancing our reputation for supporting development of complex projects. As a Partner, you will be a shareholder with an unparalleled opportunity to lead with ambition, vision, and expertise.
ERM provides:

  • Meaningful equity ownership with significant financial rewards.
  • The opportunity to participate in key decisions, including ERM’s strategic direction.
  • The ability to provide thought leadership on technical and business issues in core markets.
  • A platform to leverage ERM and use your relationships to drive opportunities and growth.
  • ERM develops integrated solutions using technology and innovation to create value for our clients. ERM’s provides a unique platform that blends business and environmental solutions to address a broad range of our client’s needs including corporate advisory (e.g., de-carbonization, supply chain, sustainability, ESG), Environment Health and Safety (EHS), social performance and Capital Project Delivery (CPD)). We embrace a whole systems thinking approach to capital deployment and capital project development that considers the technical and financial aspects in alignment with environmental, social, geopolitical, and systemic interdependencies that affect long-term value, risk, and sustainability.
  • This Critical Minerals Commercial Leader serves as a strategic advisor to mining and processing clients across the critical minerals value chain helping them navigate regulatory complexity, ESG pressures, and stakeholder expectations from early-stage concept through execution. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving business growth and developing strategic partnerships in the critical minerals sector. This role requires a deep understanding of the market, strong leadership skills, and the ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
Role Profile
As a Commercial Leader, you will be accountable for successfully selling and consulting across all ERM’s offerings to build on an established business in Lat Am. You will need to network with ERM's regional and global technical communities to share market intelligence and best practices. We are looking for an established leader who combines strong consulting and business development skills with a solid foundation in capital project delivery, and a track record of leading high performing teams to sell and deliver world-class services and outcomes.
The focus areas for this this role will be to:
  • Advance our reputation for developing challenging and complex capital projects.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities and strategic partnerships.
  • Execute ERM’s strategy of understanding clients’ businesses and delivering client value.
  • Lead and manage project execution activities in support of ERM clients’ critical minerals projects.
  • Foster and expand client relationships with critical minerals clients aligned with our growth strategy.
  • Develop new client relationships and expand existing relationships by delivering strategic consulting advice, excellent value, and quality service.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, industry partners, and government agencies.
  • Actively develop commercial strategies to pursue and win new business opportunities that result in significant growth with ERM’s target critical minerals clients.
  • Demonstrate strong understanding of client needs and raise ERM’s profile in the Latam market.
  • Drive innovation and embrace new ways of working to stay ahead of client needs and differentiate ERM in the market.
  • Help build, grow, a high-performance team, serving as a commercial leader and mentor. Identify emerging talent and help them reach their full potential through new areas of responsibility.
  • Meet business health and safety standards, financial targets, project budgets and schedules, client satisfaction, risk management, and contract requirements.
  • Preference will be given to candidates who can be based in Buenos Aires (Argen tina), Lima (Peru) or Santiago (Chile).
Qualifications
  • BA/BS/MS in environmental science, engineering, geology, business or related field.
  • 15+ years’ experience in consulting or working in the Mining and Metals Industry, with at least 7 years experience in business development related to capital project development.
  • Solid understanding of the mining industry, an established reputation in the Latam marketplace and relationships to leverage into new business.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the critical minerals market and industry trends.
  • Business acumen to understand business risks and challenges, and to recognize opportunities to provide enterprise-wide solutions for clients.
  • Demonstrable track record in delivering multi-million-dollar sales/programs.
Background:
 Since establishing our first local presence in the Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) region in the 1990s, ERM has grown steadily, now employing more than 800 professionals across offices in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Guyana, Mexico, and Peru. For over 30 years, we have built world-class consulting teams specializing in environmental, sustainability, and social consulting, with a strong client base of multiple economic sectors such as oil and gas, manufacturing, and chemical among other sectors. Through challenging times, ERM has remained committed to supporting these sectors as our clients continue to invest in the local market.
As part of our regional expansion, ERM aim to maintain industry leadership by partnering with top clients who share our commitment to sustainability. With a solid foundation in key industries, we are pioneers in advancing the ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) agenda across Latin America and the Caribbean. Our work includes contributing to sustainable finance initiatives, developing thematic studies, and supporting the implementation of international standards for local stakeholders.
Who We Are:
 As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges, and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.
We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk, and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.
If you would like to read more about Diversity, Equity, Equality & Inclusion (DE&I) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

title: Head of Security Operations
description:
Join to apply for the Head of Security Operations role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Head of Security Operations role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

Propósito

Comprar commodities agrícolas, utilizando todas as estratégias comerciais e de gestão de risco que representem as melhores práticas do mercado.

Atividades e responsabilidades

  1. Manter-se atualizado sobre as informações e tendências de mercado de commodities agrícolas, baseando-se nas consultorias indicadas pela empresa.
  2. Prospectar e/ou contactar clientes originadores e compradores de grãos; conforme a frente de atuação, seja originação ou venda; identificando oportunidades de negócio.
  3. Garantir altos níveis de satisfação dos clientes por meio de excelência nas negociações, atendendo às suas necessidades e fornecendo informações sobre o mercado de commodities agrícolas.
  4. Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes, mantendo-a atualizada por meio de inativação, remoção, cadastramento de novos clientes, inserção em blacklist, quando aplicável, e outras ações necessárias para uma base cadastral consistente que permita a gestão do relacionamento com o cliente.
  5. Registrar os contatos e relacionamento com os clientes, seja na prospecção ou no atendimento da carteira.
  6. Lançar os lotes no book de ofertas, oportunizando sua comercialização.
  7. Precificar os lotes considerando informações de mercado atualizadas e todos os componentes de precificação, seguindo os procedimentos do processo.
  8. Formalizar as negociações executando os contratos no sistema.
  9. Acompanhar os contratos do início ao fim junto à área responsável, intervindo na solução de não conformidades para garantir a excelência na execução.

Requisitos

  • Cursando graduação em áreas relacionadas a negócios.
  • CNH categoria B.
  • Residir em Rio Verde/GO ou região.
  • Disponibilidade de horário comercial, com flexibilidade pontual para viagens.

Desejável experiência e conhecimento em:

  • Office (nível intermediário).
  • Matemática comercial.
  • Leitura e gestão de indicadores.
  • Negociação de alta complexidade.
  • Fundamentos locais e globais do mercado de commodities agrícolas.
  • Formação de preço de commodities agrícolas.
  • Análise de cenário macroeconômico.
  • Estrutura, mercados e hedge com derivativos agrícolas.

  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones

  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps

  • You have understanding of agile software development methodologies
  • You collaborate effectively across multiple internal teams, building trust and delivering results
  • You have effective communications skills in English, both written and oral

title: QuantDev Analyst
description:
Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura? Então embarque nesse foguete!

>> Sobre a vaga

Essa oportunidade é para atuar na área de QuantDevs, que tem a missão de construir sistemas-chave relacionados a finanças quantitativas para as linhas de negócio de investimentos da XP. Esse é um time que desenvolve software para atender as demandas dinâmicas de áreas de Front Office e orientar a tomada de decisões financeiras.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Construção de sistemas de risco, posição e dados de mercado para as áreas de trading do banco;
  • Tomada de decisões que requerem aplicar conhecimento específico de negócio a tradeoffs nos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Fazer interlocução com stakeholders relevantes (áreas Global Markets, Tesouraria e Risco de Mercado) para entender necessidades;
  • Montar ferramentas para validação de resultados dos sistemas em construção;
  • Conhecimento de programação em linguagens de back-end (Go, C++, Python, C#, Java, etc);
  • Conhecimento de probabilidade, estatística e cálculo;
  • Familiaridade com produtos financeiros.

>> Você pode ter destaques:

  • Já tiver atuado em áreas de desenvolvimento quantitativo em outras instituições financeiras;
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido de finanças quantitativas ou engenharia financeira;
  • Ter a capacidade de construir sistemas financeiros com qualidade e velocidade em ambientes de muita autonomia.

>> Benefícios para você:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Sociedade: aqui você terá a cultura, ambiente e ferramentas que precisa para ter condições de ser dono da sua própria jornada e quem sabe até de um pedaço da empresa.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Agente Stone - Consultor(a) Comercial Externo | Sinop/MT
description:
Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento.

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes mantendo um relacionamento contínuo e pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.

description:
Aeroporto de Natal (NAT)!
Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description
Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções .
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Natal (NAT)!
Responsibilities and assignments
Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:

  • Auxiliar de Rampa
As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)
As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)
As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
Requirements And Qualifications
  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Proatividade;
  • Vontade de aprender;
  • Vontade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Disciplina e organização;
  • Disponibilidade de horário e para trabalhar em turnos rotativos presenciais;

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Directly reporting to the international director and matrix report to the Managing Director, Brazil; the Human Resources Business Partner, Manager plans and leads LATAM'S Human Resources function for the Commercial sites of the Medical Segment business. The role partners with the country leaders in aligning business objectives with developing and implementing strategies and design plans focused on human capital management, employee engagement and business performance. The HRBP maintains an effective level of business literacy about the business unit’s financial position, its business plans and directions, its culture and its competition to influence business decisions in an impactful way.

Scope: This role will support the leaders in Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and The Caribbean.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Effectively balances business partner responsibility with employee advocacy, fosters a positive culture and high performing work environment.

  • Demonstrates a relentless approach to talent:Strategic workforce planning, Talent development,Capability gap assessments,Organizational design and structure

  • Serves as a change agent and curator of culture.

  • Collaborates with HR Centers of Expertise to execute enterprise-wide programs and solutions that advance the business.

  • Develops and implements plans and actions to improve employee engagement and leadership effectiveness.

  • Supports leaders as strategist, coach, change agent, curator of culture and architect.

  • Partner with assigned business leaders and HR teams to set both long-term and short-term organization strategy and implement strategic HR initiatives to ensure the effectiveness of the organization.

  • Balances business partner responsibility with employee advocacy; builds a positive employee relations culture and work environment.

  • Develop communication plans and actions to improve employee engagement and manager effectiveness, and foster inclusion.

  • Champions talent development and movements to build organization overall capabilities and bench strength.

  • Influence and support country leaders and local leadership team in making key people or HR related decisions.

  • Participants and influence decision making on hiring of key positions and talents.

  • Influence and directs implementation of compensation and benefits programs that provide a competitive level of pay, motivation, and reward to employees.

  • Work closely with Regional HR team and establish strong network and ties with HR team.

  • Lead and participate in local and regional HR initiatives/projects as required (20% of time)

EDUCATION/TRAINING and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelors’ degree in Human Resources or related discipline. Advance degree preferred.

  • 5 to 7+ years of directly related business partner experience

  • Languages skills : Portuguese (Fluent), English (advance), Spanish (advance).

  • Previous experience working in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device industry is a plus

  • Must be able to demonstrate time management, priority management, planning and coordination, multi-tasking skills and attention to details.

  • Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing competing priorities and fast-paced work environment.

  • Ability to work independently with a high level of discretion and confidentiality required.

  • Strong computer skills and experience.

  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong ability to develop working relationships with others and understanding employee needs.

  • Solid experience in Microsoft suite, Workday, Taleo or similar.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES and CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES:

Thinks and acts strategically:

  • Is a big picture thinker using broad global perspective to develop actionable and high value local strategies.

  • Is curious and continuously asks questions to consider all possibilities and risks.

  • Synthesizes and simplifies complex data from multiple sources into actionable insights.

  • Anticipates and responds to trends and directional shifts in the marketplace to create sustained success.

Attracts, develops and retains talent:

  • Leverages individual’s strengths to build strong, diverse teams with complementary skills.

  • Identifies and advocates for high performing and high potential talent, developing strong leaders.

  • Dedicates considerable time to recruit, coach, reward, recognize, develop and mentor.

  • Ensures decisions are made at the right level.

  • Objective in assessing talent and differentiates performance.

Is aspirational and confident:

  • Embraces bold goals and dares to dream big.

  • Not afraid to take reasonable risks, constantly challenging the status quo.

  • Does not just “manage what is” but strives to create “what can be”.

  • Self-aware, learns from wins and failures and adjusts accordingly, continually seeks feedback from others.

Is an influential leader:

  • Propelled to action; makes things happen.

  • Commands respect; their perspective is insightful and sought out by others.

  • Gains support and inspires followership; can influence what is not in their direct control.

  • Develops strong relationships and demonstrates leadership across the enterprise, community, and industry.

Has personal courage and is resilient:

  • Speaks up and has a point of view even when it is unpopular and can “hold their own” when challenged.

  • Embraces and encourages new ideas and drives Customer-centric innovation.

  • Holds self and others accountable to high standards.

  • Recovers quickly after setbacks, embraces change and shows stamina through adversity.

Willing to roll up their sleeves:

  • Spends time “in the trenches” with the troops when needed.

  • Knows when to get into the details of the business.

  • Delivers results with limited resources; is willing to “do what it takes”.

  • Learns and adapts quickly.

ADDITIONAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Effectively balances business partner responsibility with employee advocacy, fosters a positive culture and high performing work environment.

  • Demonstrates a relentless approach to talent

  • Serves as a change agent and curator of culture.

  • Collaborates with HR Centers of Expertise to execute enterprise-wide programs and solutions that advance the business.

  • Develops and implements plans and actions to improve employee engagement and leadership effectiveness.

  • Supports leaders as strategist, coach, change agent, curator of culture and architect.

  • Partner with assigned business leaders and HR teams to set both long-term and short-term organization strategy and implement strategic HR initiatives to ensure the effectiveness of the organization.

  • Balances business partner responsibility with employee advocacy; builds a positive employee relations culture and work environment.

  • Develop communication plans and actions to improve employee engagement and manager effectiveness, and foster inclusion.

  • Champions talent development and movements to build organization overall capabilities and bench strength.

  • Influence and support country leaders and local leadership team in making key people or HR related decisions.

  • Participants and influence decision making on hiring of key positions and talents.

  • Influence and directs implementation of compensation and benefits programs that provide a competitive level of pay, motivation, and reward to employees.

  • Work closely with Regional HR team and establish strong network and ties with HR team.

  • Lead and participate in local and regional HR initiatives/projects as required (20% of time)

  • The LATAM HRBP Manager will navigate several LATAM countries and be able to prioritize goals that best serve the overall LATAM region (Mexico, Brazil,Colombia, Chile, …)

You’ll be working in an organization where AI is the enabler and center of its core business strategy. You want to be part of a small, intensely skilled team, who feel total ownership of their work, and can’t imagine a day without learning & coding. You will play a crucial role in the Xometry platform and everything you do will matter.

What You’ll Do:

  • At Xometry, you will play a crucial role in exploring new machine learning opportunities, researching and performing proof of concepts, and bringing new machine learning and AI solutions into Xometry’s platform.
  • Develop and implement machine learning models that improve Xometry’s ability to predict cost, price, and sourcing options for our customers and suppliers.
  • You will be responsible for leading the evaluation of emerging technologies, identifying areas for improvement, and developing new features while ensuring the reliability and scalability of Xometry’s platform.
  • Lead the exploration of emerging AI and machine learning technologies and develop proof-of-concepts to assess their potential impact on Xometry’s platform.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritize features, and define technical solutions based on the latest innovations.
  • Monitor machine learning models and AI performance and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Contribute to the documentation and knowledge base to help other teams understand and use Xometry’s AI effectively.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience with state of the art ML modeling techniques and approaches like transformers, self-supervised pre-training, generative modeling, LLMs, etc.
  • Experience with large scale data processing (e.g., hands-on experience training and applying models at scale using deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Successful candidates in this role need to be able to bridge state of the art approaches to real world impact.
  • A cloud-native software craftsperson with hands-on experience with containers, container orchestration, and distributed systems.
  • An engineer with a self-driven attitude who can own problems and deliver solutions.
  • Strong software fundamentals with experience in design patterns, refactoring, OOP, and testing.
  • A cloud practitioner who values the “shift-left” mentality by building systems with Infrastructure as Code, not console clicking.
  • Data’s at the heart of our systems, we hope it's yours too. You’re comfortable working with SQL and/or NoSQL, understand database design, and data analysis.
  • Experience building and consuming CI/CD pipelines.
  • Someone who knows their way around the command line and has experience working with *nix systems.
  • 5+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products.
  • 3+ years experience leading cross-team engineering efforts.
  • Strong execution skills in project management.

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.

Enfermeiro(a) - Serviços Hospitalares

O que você irá realizar:

Cumprir os processos e atividades de assistência aos pacientes em programa de diálise domiciliar e/ou hospitalar com diagnóstico de injúria renal aguda em recuperação, crônica ou crônica-agudizada submetidos às modalidades de Terapia Renal Substitutiva (TRS), visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o uso adequado de equipamentos de proteção individual, o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, operacionais e administrativas estabelecidas pela Franqueadora e legislação vigente, bem como a garantia da sua segurança no ambiente de trabalho. Ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Formação em Enfermagem e pós graduação em Nefrologia concluída.
  • Registro no Órgão competente ativo (COREN);
  • Experiência na área de Nefrologia e CTI;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Desejável conhecimento no pacote Office e em informática;
  • Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;

Informações complementares:

  • Local de trabalho: Minas Gerais - MG
  • Oferecemos salário e benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.
