  • Ensure integration with General Ledger (FI), Material Ledger (ML), and Inventory Accounting.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve system or process issues related to product costing.

  • Assist in SAP CO-PC system testing, documentation, and user training.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Engineering, or related field.

  • 8+ years hands-on experience in SAP Product Costing (CO-PC).

  • Strong understanding of standard costing , actual costing , and material ledger.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing cost flows , BOM/routing structures , and cost component split.

  • Experience with cost center planning , activity types , and overhead rates.

  • Solid grasp of integration between CO-PC, MM, PP, and FI modules.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret cost data and explain variances.

  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Product Costing , and Universal Journal and Material Ledger.

  • Industry experience in energy, manufacturing , automotive , utilities , or life sciences .

  • SAP certification in CO or Product Costing.

  • Experience in financial transformation or ERP migration projects.

Isso é possível, devido as nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL ), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE ), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.

Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.

Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

O que faz a área de Home Equity:
A área de Home Equity é responsável pela gestão de carteiras de crédito com garantia imobiliária, atuando desde a regularização jurídica dos ativos até sua monetização. Ela integra atividades jurídicas, comerciais e operacionais para recuperar créditos inadimplentes com imóveis dados em garantia.

  • Gestão de escritórios jurídicos e KPIs: acompanhamento de ações judiciais, substituições processuais e controle de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Controle de custos e orçamentos, planejamento de gastos com ações judiciais, leilões, notificações e bonificações por agilidade nos processos.

Strategy & Consulting Global Network at Accenture empowers our people to compete, win and grow. We develop everything they need to grow their client portfolios, optimize their deals and enable their sales talent, all driven by sales intelligence.
Solution Advisory at Accenture. Our Solution Advisory team provides a specialty sales advisory service within the Strategy & Consulting Global Network. We are specialists aligned to Accenture’s priority business offerings with expertise in how to go-to-market and best position Accenture to win new business. We are the sales lab that works with offering leadership, equipping them with relevant market insights, tailored messaging, and curated sales assets to originate, sell, and win.
M&A Solution Advisory. Within the Strategy & Consulting Global Network, our global M&A Solution Advisory team is an extension of Accenture Transaction Advisory practice. We work with M&A and Private Equity practitioners, functional / industry subject matter experts, and client account leadership to help client teams to originate deals, develop conversation starters and discussion documents, craft tailored proposals and preliminary outside-in analyses.
You are:
M&A Solution Advisory Manager. An experienced manager who is comfortable working with senior Accenture stakeholders. You have an executive presence and deep expertise in Mergers and Acquisitions. Well versed with what it takes to win consulting work, allowing you to build trust and to effectively partner with the managing directors leading the offering or drive the client pursuit. While being client facing is not necessary for this role, you exemplify client-centricity and a commitment to client value creation.
What would you do?
The M&A Solution Advisor will typically develop proposals around deal planning, transaction execution and value creation, for corporate and financial investors, in line with Accenture’s dedicated end-to-end offerings:

  • Pre-deal support, e.g., market assessment, target screening / profiling, due diligence
  • Merger integration, e.g., day 1 readiness / execution, post-close support, transition to end-state, value capture
  • Carve-out and divestiture, e.g., carve-out design, divestiture day 1 execution, new entity set-up / transition to standalone, TSA management, stranded cost management
  • Corporate / portfolio strategy, e.g., operating model design / digital transformation, re-platforming, capability scale-up, growth and portfolio strategy
  • M&A capability development, e.g., capability maturity assessment, new capability set-up

    • The M&A Solution Advisory Manager (North America) acts as an extension of the client team, developing content for all or parts of the proposal depending on the scale and complexity of the opportunity. The M&A Solution Advisory Manager provides a single point of contact for internal clients who need content, research or graphics support, building and managing relationships with stakeholders and developing trusted partnerships with them.

  • Structured thinking with a quantitative mindset
  • 5–8-year experience working on transaction management assignments and M&A programs in a client delivery role
  • Knowledge of the transaction deal lifecycle, both pre- and post-deal, including M&A constructs and definitions, allowing you to build trust and effectively partner with the managing directors leading the Transaction Advisory practice
  • Familiarity with business development work and proposal development / writing experience
  • Mastery of English at a professional level (oral and written)
  • Executive oral and written communication skills (clarity, consistency, conciseness)
  • Confidence working under time pressure in a fast-paced environment

  3. Database Management:
    1. Maintain an organized and up-to-date database in Google Drive with all legal documentation as required by the Legal Director.
    2. Ensure all documents are compliant with company policies and accessible to the Legal Director and relevant stakeholders.
  4. External Counsel Coordination & Billing Management:
    1. Support the Legal Director in coordinating the work of external counsel in various jurisdictions.
    2. Help monitor external counsel fees and legal project budgets.
  5. Collaboration with the Finance and HR Department:
    1. Assist the finance department in the opening of bank accounts for new legal entities by providing the necessary legal documentation, filling out forms, and ensuring compliance with local banking regulations.
    2. Support immigration processes by procuring all legal documentation for visa applications and work permits.
    3. Assist in matters related to labor law, including ensuring compliance with employee rights and contracts.
  6. Other Duties:
    1. Assist the Legal Director and/or Legal Managers with various legal projects and provide general support as needed.
    2. Help with preparing internal and external communications, reports, spreadsheets, org charts, and other legal presentations.

  1. Strong attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.

  3. Proactive, with a can-do attitude and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  4. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international business environment.

Requirements:

  1. Licensed to practice law in Brazil.
  2. Fluent in Spanish or English (in addition to Portuguese).
  3. Minimum 1 year of post-graduation experience .
  4. Will serve as the legal representative of the company in Brazil (with indemnity agreement).
  5. Must be a Brazilian citizen or hold permanent residency with legal work rights in Brazil.
  6. Based in Rio de Janeiro.

title: Gerente de Crédito
description:
Descrição da empresa
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.
Descrição da vaga

  • Responsável pela gestão das atividades e equipe de crédito originação G&O Brasil;
  • Fazer a gestão da equipe de crédito interior;
  • Avaliar pedidos de aprovação de crédito relacionados às operações com clientes e fornecedores no Brasil;
  • Preparar material para submeter pedidos de aprovação às alçadas superiores;
  • Garantir que a utilização de crédito de cada contraparte está em linha com os limites aprovados;
  • Fazer monitoramento constante das contrapartes com que a LDC tenha transações ativas, incluindo revisões de crédito, atualização de trade status e overlimit;
  • Revisar e atualizar políticas e procedimentos de crédito conforme necessário;
  • Garantir que as políticas e procedimentos de crédito estão sendo respeitados pelas diferentes áreas da companhia;
  • Promover treinamentos internos para comunicar e divulgar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de crédito;
  • Manter contato constante com Departamento Jurídico a fim de: (a) acompanhar e participar de decisões relacionadas a recuperação de créditos em litígio; (b) verificar se as garantias de créditos aprovados estão corretamente registradas; (c) promover ajustes nas estruturas de garantias requeridas com intuito de proteger a companhia e se adaptar a mudanças na legislação, jurisprudência e práticas de mercado;
  • Promover constante diálogo com as plataformas de negócio a fim de entender o contexto atual de mercado e situação das principais contrapartes com quem temos operações/exposições;
  • Liderar o relacionamento com os corretores e seguradoras referente as apólices de seguro de crédito;
  • Preparar materiais e relatórios a serem compartilhados com a equipe Global de Crédito e demais regiões;
  • Prestar suporte as áreas de Crédito em outras regiões da LDC referente as transações que envolverem contrapartes brasileiras;
  • Organizar visitas a clientes e fornecedores para obtenção de informações necessárias para as avaliações de crédito;
  • Gestão de risco de mark-to-market da carteira G&O Brasil.
Qualificações
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, ou cursos correlatos;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Sólida experiência na área de crédito;
  • Conhecimento de crédito rural e garantias;
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas;
  • Vivência com projetos de transformação digital;
  • Excel avançado;
Informações adicionais
Additional Information for the job
Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade
A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.

Enfermeiro(a) - Serviços Hospitalares

O que você irá realizar:

Cumprir os processos e atividades de assistência aos pacientes em programa de diálise domiciliar e/ou hospitalar com diagnóstico de injúria renal aguda em recuperação, crônica ou crônica-agudizada submetidos às modalidades de Terapia Renal Substitutiva (TRS), visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o uso adequado de equipamentos de proteção individual, o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, operacionais e administrativas estabelecidas pela Franqueadora e legislação vigente, bem como a garantia da sua segurança no ambiente de trabalho. Ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto.

  2. Registro no Órgão competente ativo (COREN);
  3. Experiência na área de Nefrologia e CTI;
  4. Disponibilidade de horário;
  5. Desejável conhecimento no pacote Office e em informática;
  6. Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;

Informações complementares:

  1. Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP
  2. Unidades em vários locais.

Oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

About the Company:
World is a network of real humans, built on privacy-preserving proof-of-human technology, and powered by a globally inclusive financial network that enables the free flow of digital assets for all. It is built to connect, empower, and be owned by everyone.
About the Company:
World is an open-source protocol, supported by a global community of developers, individuals, economists and technologists committed to expanding participation in, and access to, the global economy. Its community is united around core beliefs in the inherent worth and equality of every individual, the right to personal privacy, and open and public collaboration. These beliefs are reflected in what the community is building: a public utility to connect everyone to the global economy.
The World Foundation is the protocol’s steward and will support and grow the Worldcoin community until it becomes self-sufficient. Tools for Humanity is a global hardware and software development company. It helped launch Worldcoin and continues to provide support to the Foundation, in addition to operating the World App.
About the team:
The World ID team is on a mission to empower every person on the planet with a unique digital identity that distinguishes humans from AI online.
As the driving force behind World ID, the team oversees the entire lifecycle of the product—from user experiences to developer interactions. Our goal is to establish a decentralized identity protocol that is open for any developer to contribute to and build upon.
Built on Web3 technology, World ID prioritizes privacy, security, and data self-custody as foundational principles. We ensure that users maintain full control of their data, setting a new standard for privacy in the digital age.
Challenges and opportunities we tackle include:

  • Scaling globally with local relevance, ensuring World ID works for people across diverse regions and contexts.
  • Building a vibrant global developer community that spans both Web2 and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Bridging the gap between Web2 and Web3, making the transition seamless for users and developers.
  • Empowering users to control their own data through data minimization at internet scale.
  • Introducing a new, privacy-preserving digital credential to the evolving digital identity ecosystem.
Together, we are redefining what it means to own and protect your digital identity in a decentralized world.
About the Opportunity:
As a Partner Product Manager for World ID, you will play a critical role in driving product adoption and market fit through strategic partnerships. You will work directly with partner organizations, developing and implementing solutions that leverage World ID’s capabilities to meet diverse user and business needs across different regions and contexts. This role requires a highly entrepreneurial mindset, as you’ll be responsible for defining and executing on a roadmap with external partners and representing World ID’s product vision beyond our team.

  • Lead Partner-Focused Product Initiatives: Work closely with partner organizations to understand their specific needs and co-develop solutions that integrate World ID into their ecosystems.

  • Engage with Partners and Users: Regularly interact with partners and their users to gather insights that inform your roadmap and improve the partner and end-user experience with World ID.
  • Act as a Liaison Between Product and Partners: Serve as an extension of the core product team, translating partner feedback into actionable product requirements and ensuring World ID’s offerings are effectively communicated and implemented in the market.
  • Champion Product Metrics and Success: Define and track key metrics that measure the success and impact of World ID’s implementations within partner solutions.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and marketing, to deliver cohesive partner solutions and drive go-to-market initiatives.
  • Navigate Early-Stage Product Market Fit Challenges: Embrace the ambiguity and challenges of reaching product market fit , bringing agility, creativity, and an outcome-focused approach to solve problems and adapt as necessary.

  • Strong entrepreneurial mindset with experience in a fast-paced, early-stage product environment.

Sobre a Shô
Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor.

Modelo de Trabalho

Qual será a sua missão
O time de Planejamento de Hubs faz parte da estrutura da Shopee Express, o braço de logística próprio da Shopee. Somos o time responsável por criar e monitorar o planejamento operacional para Hubs (LM & FM) para atendimento da demanda e para melhor tomada de decisão em
custo (HC, insumos e equipamentos) e qualidade, alinhando a operação e a estratégia da companhia. No dia a dia, o time está em contato tanto com a operação, quanto com altas lideranças e outros times (S&OP, Network Design, Transportation, Cross-dockings, Product, etc.). Portanto, buscamos pessoas com fortes competências analíticas (que goste de análises numéricas das mais simples até as mais complexas), boas
competências de comunicação interpessoal (tenha uma boa interlocução com times operacionais e corporativos) e muita vontade de querer crescer junto conosco, construindo os processos de planejamento da potencial maior transportadora do Brasil.
Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Analisar/executar a demanda recebida de S&OP e as metas estabelecidas pela companhia para operações FLMHubs;
  • Construir planos de capacidade máxima a médio/longo prazo para operações FLMHubs;
  • Projetar necessidade de recursos a longo prazo: a) HC direto e indireto, b) equipamentos, c) insumos não-consumíveis;

  • Avaliar e propor pontos de melhoria nos processos e ferramentas que possam auxiliar o monitoramento e controle operacional;
  • Manutencionar agendas de governança para prover informações de qualidade e com embasamento analítico às áreas parceiras (Network, Ops Hubs, Fleet, FP&A, Procurement, WFM);

  • Resultados Esperados: Desenhar e revisar periodicamente planos de capacidade otimizados e passíveis de serem executados por operações FLMHubs com vistas ao atendimento de metas da companhia;

We are looking for an experienced AWS Sales Account Manager focused on Digital Native Business (DNB)accounts.
The candidate should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against an account coverage plan and consistently deliver on revenue targets. The candidate should possess both a sales and technical background that enables him or her to drive engagement at the CXO at LoB level as well as with CIO, software developers, IT architects, and other customer executives.
Successful candidates will have executive level experience in leading, defining, designing and deploying enterprise level strategic solutions in the DNB domain
In this role, the candidate will work with a small set of large DNB customers, where a prescriptive and in-depth approach is required. The ability to understand complex business requirements and provide tailored solutions is crucial.
The AWS DND Account Manager will be a strong analytical thinker who thrives in fast-paced dynamic environments and has very strong communication, writing and presentation skills. Additionally, the ability to work with extended teams and coordinate their efforts is essential for success in this role.
Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption in a defined set of accounts to meet or exceed revenue targets;
  • Develop and execute against a strategic plan that leads to the creation and maintenance of a robust sales pipeline including opportunities in existing accounts as well as driving net new business in untapped customers;
  • Manage numerous accounts concurrently & strategically;
  • Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS;
  • Analyze sales/metrics data from your accounts to help evolve your strategy;
  • Accelerate customer adoption through education and engagement;
  • Solid skills working with partners to manage joint selling opportunities;
  • Assist DNB customer in identifying use cases for priority adoption of Amazon Web Services as well as best practices implementations;

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

  • 7+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience

Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer familiar with hardware.
The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact for adoption of Linux across multiple device categories and industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.
We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.
Role description
We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.
The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.
Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in-house teams and industry partners.
  • Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.
  • Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).
  • Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.
  • Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year.
Required Skills And Experience
  • Knowledge of Python programming language.
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.
  • Interest in test automation methodologies.
  • Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.
  • Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.
Desired Skills And Experience
  • Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.
  • Experience working in an agile environment.
  • Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
What is Canonical?
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product Manager (Enterprise Customer Success)
description:
Amplitude is the leading digital analytics platform that helps companies unlock the power of their products. Over 4,000 customers, including Atlassian, NBCUniversal, Under Armour, Shopify, and Jersey Mike’s, rely on Amplitude to gain self-service visibility into the entire customer journey. Amplitude guides companies every step of the way as they capture data they can trust, uncover clear insights about customer behavior, and take faster action. When teams understand how people are using their products, they can deliver better product experiences that drive growth. Amplitude is the best-in-class analytics solution for product, data, and marketing teams, ranked #1 in multiple categories in G2’s Spring 2025 Report. Learn how to optimize your digital products and business atamplitude.com .

As an organization, we approach challenges with humility, take ownership of our contributions, and embrace a growth mindset that pushes us to constantly improve ourselves, each other, and the value we bring to customers and partners.

Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

The candidate MUST be located in one of the city locations listed below:

Atlanta, Georgia

Austin, Texas

Sao Paulo, Brazil

Mexico City, Mexico

About the Role & Team

In this unique role as a Product Manager within Amplitude’s Enterprise Customer Success team , you’ll leverage your deep expertise in product management and analytics to strategically advise our customers, enabling them to build exceptional digital products using Amplitude’s analytics platform. You’ll directly support a diverse portfolio of enterprise accounts across LATAM and North America, collaborating closely with product executives, analytics leaders, and growth teams to drive adoption and ensure maximum value realization.

You’re someone who understands what it takes to develop outstanding digital products—experienced with agile product methodologies, fluent in analytics, and skilled in platforms like Amplitude. You’ll utilize these skills to guide customers toward informed product decisions, strategic adoption, and sustained growth.

As a Product Manager on our Customer Success Team, you will:
  • Collaborate closely with customers’ Product, Analytics, and Growth teams to create and execute strategic plans that achieve key product goals and growth metrics.
  • Advise senior customer executives (e.g., Chief Product Officers, VPs of Product, Heads of Analytics) on effectively leveraging Amplitude analytics to inform their product strategy and development.
  • Conduct strategic business reviews and in-depth analytics sessions, demonstrating measurable impact and uncovering new opportunities for product adoption and growth.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Amplitude’s internal teams—including Sales, Product, and Professional Services—to ensure customer feedback meaningfully influences product enhancements and adoption initiatives.
  • Regularly analyze product usage patterns, identify health metrics, and proactively suggest actionable insights to customers that enhance their long-term success and value from Amplitude.
You’ll be a great addition to the team if you have:
  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Growth Product Manager, or in a similar role within SaaS or digital-first companies.
  • Hands-on experience using analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Heap, etc.) to inform product decisions and strategies.
  • Proven success working with enterprise-scale customers, influencing senior executives, and driving adoption of sophisticated SaaS solutions.
  • A strong track record in defining product strategies, developing roadmaps, and prioritizing initiatives that deliver clear business outcomes.
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex analytical insights into actionable product recommendations.
  • Outstanding business acumen with the communication skills to convey technical and strategic concepts clearly and effectively to senior executives.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
Travel Expectation
  • Approximately 5+ days per month .
Who We Are

The Company: Amplitude is filled with humble, life-long learners who are eager to help one another and the company succeed. Our values of growth mindset, ownership, and humility are core to the way we work: we’re tenacious in the face of challenges, we take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared success, and we operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

The Product: Amplitude is a digital analytics platform—we help companies capture data they can trust, uncover clear insights about customer behavior, and take faster action. This empowers teams to build better product experiences that drive business growth. We’re super proud of what we’ve built and continue to expand: a platform that empowers companies to thrive in the digital era.

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • We were recognized in the Newsweek Excellence Index 2024 .
  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 19 quarters in a row on G2.
  • We care A LOT about product innovation. Fast Company called us the #3 most innovative enterprise company in the world.
  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.
  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.
  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.
  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom..

description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.

Enfermeiro(a) Supervisor Hemodiálise

O que você irá realizar:

Responsável por assegurar o cumprimento dos processos e atividades diárias de assistência e cuidados ao paciente com doença renal crônica em programa de diálise, o cumprimento da prescrição de diálise pela equipe de técnicos de enfermagem sob sua supervisão, visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, bem como a garantia da segurança do paciente;

Responde pelas atividades realizadas pelos técnicos de enfermagem na assistência ao paciente com doença renal, minimizando riscos durante o tratamento.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Graduação em Enfermagem (com comprovação de registro no COREN ativo);

  • Experiência como Enfermeiro na área de Nefrologia;

  • Ter disponibilidade de horário;

  • Conhecimentos das Legislações e regulamentações inerentes à área de Nefrologia;

  • Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;

Diferenciais:

  • Desejável Especialização em Nefrologia (completa ou em andamento);

  • Desejável conhecimentos de Legislação Trabalhista/Sindical, nos aspectos relacionados à gestão de pessoas/equipe.

Informações complementares:

  • Local de trabalho: Brasília - DF

  • Oferecemos salário e benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

A Fresenius Medical Care agradece o seu interesse e disponibilidade em participar de nosso processo seletivo!

  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além de habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;
  • Execução de operações nos mercados à vista, futuro e a termo;
  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

  • Nossa cultura de mente aberta torna o ambiente horizontal para que as decisões sejam tomadas com base em fatos e dados, colocando os interesses dos clientes sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Com espírito empreendedor, cada um de nós protagoniza a sua própria história , então não espere encontrar uma empresa que tome decisões por você.
  • Apesar de todos terem autonomia para assumir as rédeas da própria vida, a nossa rotina é intensa por sonharmos grande e amarmos o que fazemos.

  • Ser curioso e agente de mudança

  • Conhecimento em Renda Variável
  • Certificação PQO Operacional

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações
  • Certificação CPA-20

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. Job Description: Executive Assistant

About the Role : We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to provide exceptional support to our C-Suite Executive. The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented professional with outstanding calendar management abilities, excellent communication skills, and a remarkable capacity to respond swiftly and effectively to dynamic business needs. As the Executive Assistant, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of the executive's office and contribute to the overall success of the organization.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Calendar Management:

  • Efficiently manage the executive's calendar, scheduling and coordinating appointments, meetings, conferences, and travel arrangements.
  • Prioritize conflicting demands, anticipate scheduling conflicts, and recommend solutions to optimize the executive's time.

Communication:

  • Act as a liaison between the executive and internal/external stakeholders, effectively conveying messages and instructions with utmost professionalism.
  • Craft and draft emails, memos, reports, and other communications on behalf of the executive.
  • Display exceptional responsiveness by promptly attending to incoming communication, requests, and inquiries on behalf of the executive.
  • Address urgent matters and manage last-minute changes to the executive's schedule with poise and adaptability.

Administrative Support:

  • Provide comprehensive administrative support, including managing correspondence, preparing presentations, and handling expense reports.
  • Maintain an organized filing system, ensuring easy retrieval of documents and information.

Travel Coordination:

  • Arrange complex domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, transportation, and itinerary planning.
  • Ensure the executive's travel arrangements align with their preferences and business requirements.

Event Coordination:

  • Assist in organizing and coordinating events, meetings, and conferences, both internal and external.
  • Collaborate with other team members to ensure the seamless execution of events.

Confidentiality and Discretion:

  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality.

Problem Solving:

  • Quickly and proactively resolve issues and challenges that arise in the course of supporting the executive, demonstrating resourcefulness and good judgment.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience.
  • 1-2 years experience as an Executive Assistant supporting high-level executives, department heads/leads based in an English-speaking country.
  • Previous experience working in a digitally focused organization, digital marketing preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient in using office software and tools, including calendar management applications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work well under pressure.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.

O que são diferenciais?
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office);
Como funciona nosso processo seletivo?
  • Etapa 1 (Triagem): Se inscreva na nossa página de oportunidades (Não esqueça de completar seu cadastro!)
  • Etapa 2 (Entrevista Técnica): Se aprovado(a), passe por uma entrevista com o lider da área;
  • Etapa 3 (Entrevista Comportamental): Se aprovado, passe por uma entrevista com o gestor da área de talent aquisition.

title: Strategic Account Manager- Marketplace, Brazil Amazon Marketplace
description:
Are you looking for a challenging career in development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Key Account Manager to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Your role will be focused on managing top strategic accounts to help them grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems, and tools. You will have an important role in relationship building and engagement, making sure accounts are performing as expected and have your support for development.
Lastly, you will be responsible for using feedback from sellers to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems, and tools.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Manage a set of strategic and relevant accounts for Amazon to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets.
  2. Be a partner for Key Accounts providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon.
  3. Work closely with merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience.
  4. Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory, and performance efficiently and to the required standards.
  5. Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items, and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants.
  6. Track and report development results, analyze and interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants.
  7. Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of sales or marketing work (like e-commerce, retail technology, SaaS) or equivalent experience.
- Experience managing and growing large accounts, product marketing, or management consulting roles.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience influencing at all levels within an organization, particularly at the executive level.
- Experience exceeding sales targets using a consultative, solutions-focused approach or equivalent.

São Paulo, São Paulo, Brazil

A Marketdata é uma das mais renomadas consultorias de estratégia de dados e tecnologia, fazendo parte do Grupo VML, que integra a gigante mundial WPP, maior conglomerado de comunicação do mundo. O grupo é conhecido por suas transformações impactantes em mercados locais e internacionais através de soluções criativas e inovadoras. Uma das maiores consultorias de Data Driven Marketing da América Latina, altamente especializada em CRM e Loyalty.

Com uma história de 24 anos repleta de conquistas e em um momento de franca expansão internacional, a Marketdata se destaca não apenas por sua trajetória impressionante, mas também por seu compromisso inabalável com a inovação, a tecnologia e a análise profunda de dados. Ao longo de sua jornada, acumulou inúmeros prêmios internacionais e nacionais: A Marketdata foi eleita, por 11 vezes, a Melhor Empresa de CRM do Ano, pela Associação Brasileira de Marketing de Dados (ABEMD), além de ser a maior vencedora da categoria de Marketing Baseado em Dados do Prêmio Echo Latam.

Na Marketdata, valorizamos não apenas os resultados, mas acima de tudo, as pessoas. Fomentamos relações humanas sólidas e promovemos valores como comprometimento, excelência, flexibilidade, ética e inovação. Estamos firmemente comprometidos com a inclusão, a diversidade e a preservação do meio ambiente.

Além disso, conquistamos o selo Great Place to Work Brasil. Este reconhecimento é fruto da dedicação de todos os nossos colabores que, diariamente, fortalecem uma cultura que transborda nossos valores.

Buscamos talentos que compartilhem de nossa visão e que desejem fazer parte de uma equipe onde o senso de pertencimento é valorizado, e onde juntos, contribuímos para um futuro mais sustentável e inclusivo. Se você se identifica com esses valores, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe na Marketdata.

Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença!

Profissional será a linha de frente do projeto, conduzindo junto com o cliente a construção das estrategias de CRM, operacionalizando campanhas, tocando multiplos cronogramas e entregas ao longo do tempo. Será responsável pelos estudos, estrategia de campanhas e retorno das campanhas junto com o analista de dados.

  • Vale Refeição (inclusive no mês das férias)
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Marketdata Academy (Treinamentos mensais à disposição dos colaboradores)
  • Parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino
  • Convênio com Cinemark
  • Programa interno de orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica
  • Happy Day (day off no dia do aniversário)
  • Wellhub
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade Estendidos

Na VML, estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho totalmente inclusivo que seja gratificante e que impulsione a carreira. Acreditamos na criação de um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico que valorize a diversidade e a inclusão e nos esforçamos para recrutar uma lista diversificada de candidatos para nos ajudar a atingir esse objetivo. Teremos o prazer de fornecer adaptações razoáveis a pessoas com deficiência que precisem de uma adaptação para usar ou acessar o site de carreiras da VML ou para participar plenamente do processo de candidatura. Caso necessite de uma adaptação para concluir a sua candidatura ou outro aspeto do nosso processo de recrutamento devido a uma deficiência, entre em contato com o nosso departamento de Recursos Humanos ou envie um e-mail para (contato de RH) para solicitar uma adaptação.

Ao clicar em "Enviar Candidatura", as informações que você inserir abaixo serão encaminhadas para a VML. Recomendamos que, antes de prosseguir, você consulte a nossa Política de Privacidade de Recrutamento. Residentes da Califórnia devem consultar o nosso Aviso de Privacidade de Recrutamento da Califórnia . Nestes documentos, explicamos como tratamos os seus dados pessoais no âmbito do processo de candidatura, bem como a forma como poderá atualizar ou remover as informações que nos forneceu.

This job is with Sony Pictures Entertainment, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
General Summary
We are seeking a versatile creative and detail-oriented Sr Digital Graphic Designer to join our team. This position requires a skilled visual storyteller who can bring complex ideas to life through dynamic presentations and compelling graphic design. The ideal candidate is proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, Apple Keynote, MS power point and other visual communication tools, with a strong portfolio showcasing both presentation and design work.
The Sr Digital Graphic Designer will partner with all Creative units including Project managers team to ensure highest industry standards, brand cohesiveness and elevate the quality of all initiatives for Digital Products and other line of business.
Core Responsibilities
Presentation Design:

  • Design and build impactful keynote/powerpoint presentations that support executive speeches, sales pitches, product launches, and conferences.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to transform messaging and data into visually engaging presentations.
  • Maintain brand consistency across all presentation materials.
  • Incorporate animations, transitions, and multimedia to enhance storytelling.
Graphic Design
  • Create visual assets for all digital and print media requests, including social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, web and product interfaces.
  • Explore and integrate AI-powered design tools to improve design workflows. (e.g.generative design apps, automation platforms).
  • Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to develop campaign visuals and brand materials.
  • Production work (eg: Art adaptations, resizing, image/material curation)
  • Contribute to brand development and ensure adherence to brand guidelines.
  • Handle multiple design projects from concept through execution under tight deadlines.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, Visual Communication, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design with a strong emphasis on presentation design.
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign), Apple Keynote, MS Powerpoint
  • Strong portfolio showcasing presentation and graphic design work.
  • Excellent understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and composition.
  • Ability to translate abstract ideas into visual narratives.
  • Strong communication, time management, and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to deliver high-quality work under pressure.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in a fast-paced agency or corporate environment.
  • Understanding of UX/UI principles is a bonus.
  • Motion graphics and video editing skills (After Effects, Premiere Pro) not required but are a plus.
Knowledge/Abilities
  • Strong problem-solving skills and detail oriented. Ability to work effectively under changing environments.
  • Ability to manage projects from concept through execution unsupervised.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to lead projects and collaborate with other designers and/or teams.
  • Strong ability to work on multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • English is a must.

title: Kubernetes Operations Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Join to apply for the Kubernetes Operations Engineer (m/f/d) role at Skaylink BR

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Kubernetes Operations Engineer (m/f/d) role at Skaylink BR

  • CKS – Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist.
Como Engenheiro(a) de Operações Kubernetes, você será peça-chave na construção, operação e otimização de ambientes de containers altamente disponíveis, seguros e escaláveis, baseados em Kubernetes.
Usando sua experiência e paixão por automação, cloud e infraestrutura como código, você irá apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de ambientes modernos, além de garantir a estabilidade, performance e segurança das operações em nuvem.
Venha fazer parte do nosso time e ajude a desenvolver plataformas cloud-native que sustentam os desafios de hoje e já estão preparadas para as demandas do futuro!
Responsabilidades chave
  • Implantar, configurar e manter clusters Kubernetes (kubeadm, k3s, RKE).
  • Gerenciar redes (CNI como Calico, Cilium) e armazenamento (CSI, PV/PVC).
  • Realizar atualizações, backups, monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana) e troubleshooting.
  • Operar workloads Kubernetes na AWS e Azure, incluindo ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud.
  • Configurar redes, armazenamento e permissões (IAM/RBAC) em nuvem.
  • Otimizar escalabilidade automática (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler).
  • Gerenciar aplicações com Helm, Kustomize e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança (RBAC, políticas de rede, gestão de segredos).
  • Automatizar operações com scripts (Python, Go, Bash) e IaC (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Documentar configurações, processos operacionais e procedimentos de suporte.
Habilidades Essenciais
  • Sólido conhecimento da arquitetura Kubernetes (control plane e worker nodes).
  • Uso avançado do kubectl para gestão, troubleshooting e administração de clusters.
  • Experiência com Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs, CronJobs, Ingress e Services.
  • Domínio de Helm para empacotamento e deploy de aplicações.
  • Forte expertise em Docker, redes de containers, armazenamento e segurança.
  • Administração avançada de Linux (rede, armazenamento, performance, segurança).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em redes (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls, CNI e network policies).
  • Automação com Python, Go, Bash e ferramentas de IaC (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experiência prática com pipelines CI/CD para deploy em Kubernetes.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Loki, Jaeger).
Profundo conhecimento em Hardware, Redes, Segurança e Hyperscaler
  • Hardware: Conhecimento sólido em arquitetura de servidores, gargalos de recursos (CPU, memória, disco, rede) e tipos de armazenamento (DAS, SAN, NAS) aplicados ao Kubernetes.
  • Redes: Domínio de VPC/VNet, roteamento, security groups, load balancers (L4/L7), DNS, VPNs e integração das redes do Kubernetes com infraestrutura de nuvem.
  • Segurança: Implementação de boas práticas com RBAC, NetworkPolicies, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS), segurança de containers, proteção em runtime e auditoria. Conhecimento avançado em IAM para controle de acesso e provisionamento no Kubernetes.
  • Nuvem (AWS & Azure): Experiência prática com compute (EC2, VMs, Auto Scaling), redes (VPC, Load Balancers, DNS), armazenamento (EBS, Azure Disks, S3, Blob) e controle de acesso (IAM).
  • Kubernetes Gerenciado (EKS/AKS): Atuação direta na configuração, otimização e troubleshooting de clusters EKS e AKS, incluindo integração com serviços de nuvem.
Certificações necessárias e desejáveis
  • Necessárias:
  • Certificação CKA – Certified Kubernetes Administrator.
  • Uma certificação de nível associate em nuvem:
  • AWS (Solutions Architect Associate ou SysOps Associate) ou
  • Azure (Azure Administrator Associate – AZ-104).
  • Desejáveis:
  • CKS – Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist.
  • Certificação de nível profissional em nuvem:
  • AWS (Solutions Architect Professional ou DevOps Professional) ou
  • Azure (Solutions Architect Expert – AZ-305 ou DevOps Expert – AZ-400).
  • CKAD – Certified Kubernetes Application Developer.
  • Certificações Linux relevantes (RHCSA, LFCS ou similares).

title: As Essenciais Obras da Literatura Latino-Americana
description:
A diversidade cultural é uma marca distintiva da literatura latino-americana, que brilha ao retratar a beleza singular de seus povos e paisagens. Nos últimos anos, tem havido um interesse crescente por autores e obras dessa região.

Com o intuito de incentivar o hábito de leitura e explorar além dos populares best-sellers, este artigo oferece recomendações de livros imprescindíveis para enriquecer sua estante. A seguir, apresentamos seis obras essenciais da literatura latina. Vamos descobrir juntos?

O livro dos abraços, de Eduardo Galeano

Falecido em 2015, o escritor uruguaio Eduardo Galeano tinha o dom de transformar pequenos enredos em histórias notáveis. Sua obra não fala apenas de fatos comuns, mas da vida e de tudo o que ela representa.

Talvez seu livro mais famoso, As veias abertas da América Latina , publicado em 1971, aborda trajetórias políticas dos países latino-americanos, discutindo imperialismo, capitalismo e subdesenvolvimento. Entretanto, o livro da imagem, O livro dos abraços , fala dos pequenos momentos, da beleza e emoção da memória como algo vivo e inquieto.

A pele do céu, de Elena Poniatowska

Elena Poniatowska nasceu em Paris, mas mudou para o México aos 10 anos, onde vive até hoje. Em suma, seu livro A pele do céu nos leva à zona rural mexicana e às memórias de infância do protagonista, Lorenzo, que conhece Fausta, uma figura meio hippie, moderna, bissexual, que o convida a fugir do pragmatismo de sua vida.

O corpo em que nasci, de Guadalupe Nettel

Outra autora mexicana importante, Guadalupe Nettel, aborda em seu livro O corpo em que nasci a fronteira entre ficção e autobiografia. A narrativa gira em torno da personagem principal, que narra a partir do divã de seu analista, abordando temas como infância, exilados de ditaduras na Argentina e Chile, e as vias de aceitação de si mesma.

A protagonista tem um problema no olho direito, que a faz usar um tampão, tornando sua visão borrada, suportando a rejeição ao seu redor. Uma obra sobre temas delicados e necessários.

Roberto Bolaño, autor chileno, é conhecido pelo seu romance Os detetives selvagens , vencedor do Prêmio Rómulo Gallegos , com narrativa em três momentos.

No primeiro e último momentos, temos a narrativa em forma de diário de García Madero, aspirante a poeta. No segundo, relatos de diferentes pessoas, com a intenção de instigar o leitor a trabalhar como um detetive, relacionando fatos e reconstruindo sua própria história.

Meu país inventado, de Isabel Allende

Isabel Allende nasceu em Lima, Peru. Seu primeiro romance, A casa dos espíritos , foi premiado e a consolidou como uma importante escritora latino-americana. Seu livro Em Meu país inventado retoma lembranças do Chile, onde foi criada, e narra a história do país com humor e sagacidade.

Gabriel García Márquez, autor colombiano, é famoso pelo livro Cem anos de solidão , admirado e traduzido em muitos países. Outro livro, Doze contos peregrinos , apresenta latino-americanos vivendo na Europa, imigrantes que sentem saudades de suas terras natais e enfrentam o estranhamento cultural do velho continente.

Literatura latino-americana, muito além do convencional

A literatura latino-americana revela-se um vasto universo, transcendendo limites do convencional. Suas páginas contêm histórias profundas, reflexões instigantes e uma riqueza cultural que ressoa além das fronteiras. Ao explorar esse mundo literário, somos convidados a mergulhar em narrativas que ecoam as vozes de uma região vibrante e diversificada. Que continuemos a celebrar e valorizar essa expressão artística tão única, reconhecendo sua importância e impacto duradouro na paisagem literária global.

Join to apply for the Head of Security Operations role at Canonical

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture

  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools

title: Head of Security Operations
description:

Join to apply for the Head of Security Operations role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

title: Banco de talentos
description:
Descrição do Cargo:

A empresa está em constante busca por profissionais talentosos e motivados em várias áreas de atuação. Se você é um indivíduo apaixonado, proativo e com habilidades excepcionais, queremos conhecê-lo! Este é um anúncio para o nosso banco de talentos geral, onde estaremos coletando currículos para oportunidades futuras em diversas áreas, tais como:

  • Tecnologia da Informação (TI);
  • Vendas;
  • Finanças e Contabilidade;
  • Recursos Humanos (RH);
  • Engenharia;
  • Operações;
  • Atendimento ao Cliente;
  • Desenvolvimento de Produto;
  • Suprimentos e Logística;
  • E outras áreas conforme necessário.

Quem somos

Bem-vindo ao Grupo Novo Horizonte, uma história que combina o sabor tradicional mineiro com o frescor vibrante do Pará. Iniciamos nossa trajetória no Pará em 2000, quando os sócios Tarcísio e Lúcio vislumbraram a oportunidade de desenvolver o setor de frangos de corte na região.

Ao longo dos anos, expandimos nossas operações para o Amapá, conquistando destaque no setor. Em 2016, atraímos a atenção da líder de frango de corte do Pará, a Frango Americano, e decidimos direcionar nosso foco para o segmento de ovos.

Atualmente, somos líderes na produção de ovos no estado, contribuindo com mais de 400 mil ovos diariamente. Nossa indústria é fruto do empenho de mais de 340 colaboradores dedicados a oferecer alimentos frescos e de qualidade à população local.

Na Novo Horizonte, destacamos a fusão única entre o sabor mineiro e o frescor paraense. Cada produto é uma expressão dessa combinação, resultando em alimentos que unem tradição e qualidade.

Missão

Superar as barreiras da diversidade e oferecer aos clientes um produto dentro dos mais altos padrões de qualidade do início ao final da produção, garantindo preço competitivo, excelência no atendimento e satisfação de nossos clientes.

Visão

Ser um grupo de referência na produção e comercialização de frangos de corte, ovos in natura e pasteurizados na região Norte do Brasil, focado na qualidade dos alimentos e crescimento sustentável, a fim de superar as expectativas do consumidor.

Valores

  • Mentalidade de dono;
  • Foco no Cliente;
  • Agilidade e Adaptação;
  • Inovação Constante;
  • Aprendizado Contínuo;
  • Honestidade e Integridade;
  • Compromisso com a Comunidade Local;
  • Prioridade na Qualidade;
  • Valorização das Pessoas;
  • Responsabilização Ambiental;
  • Trabalho em Equipe.

  11. Proficiency in SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, or Blackline; strong Excel skills are required.

  13. Strong analytical skills to interpret complex financial data.

Preferred Skills:

HDR Engineering is currently seeking an Electrical Distribution Project Manager to join our growing and nationally ranked team of Power Delivery professionals.
Opportunities are available in these preferred locations: Austin, Ann Arbor, Boise, Bismark, Billings, Charlotte, Chicago, Denver, Irvine, Fort Worth, Houston, Honolulu, Kansas City, Madison, Minneapolis, Missoula, Omaha, Phoenix, Portland (OR & ME), Richmond, Raleigh Sacramento/Folsom, San Diego, Seattle, Spokane, St Louis, Syracuse.
Primary Responsibilities
As part of a well-established Power Delivery practice, you will have the opportunity to manage overhead and/or underground distribution line projects in the local region and beyond. You will likely have prior experience managing and providing technical leadership on small/medium projects and are now ready to take-on a broader role overseeing all aspects of larger and more complex distribution line projects.
Additionally, you will leverage existing staff across the company to deliver projects and support business development for new opportunities and proposal development within the practice.
As an Electrical Distribution Project Manager, your role will encompass the following:

  • Managing and leading distribution projects throughout the entire project life cycle, including scope and/or proposal development, project team development and assignment, project execution, project closeout, quality control, schedule, and budget management.
  • Working independently and/or directing, mentoring, training, and/or supervising one or more Project Engineers, EITs, Designers, CADD Technicians and administrative staff.
  • Leading the QA/QC process on projects per HDR’s Quality Management Systems (QMS) requirements with a commitment to delivering world class quality.
  • At times, being responsible for overseeing non-engineering components of projects, including public involvement, environmental permitting, right of way acquisition, construction management, and other services.
  • Providing project team member oversight over workload, quality, utilization, team morale, training, and performing annual performance reviews of team members.
  • Leveraging existing staff across the company to execute work and deliver world class services to clients in the region.
  • Performing client management, project management, staff supervision, and/or technical support activities.
  • May coordinate with HDR’s Talent Acquisition team and leadership to develop a hiring plan to help build and grow a group of distribution professionals.
  • At times, supporting and engaging in broader business development activities with existing and target clients in the region.

  • Minimum 4 years of distribution design experience.
  • Minimum 6 years of overall experience including prior project management and staff management experience.

  • Track record of working cooperatively with diverse teams, regional, department, technical managers and project staff
